verses.en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
verses.fr: Commencement de l''Evangile de Jésus-Christ, Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወንጌል መጀመሪያ።

verses.en: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.fr: Selon ce qui est écrit dans Esaïe, le prophète: Voici, j''envoie devant toi mon messager, Qui préparera ton chemin;

verses.en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.fr: C''est la voix de celui qui crie dans le désert: Préparez le chemin du Seigneur, Aplanissez ses sentiers.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ ተብሎ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ እንደ ተጻፈ፥

verses.en: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
verses.fr: Jean parut, baptisant dans le désert, et prêchant le baptême de repentance, pour la rémission des péchés.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ በምድረ በዳ እያጠመቀ የንስሐንም ጥምቀት ለኃጢአት ስርየት እየሰበከ መጣ።

verses.en: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.fr: Tout le pays de Judée et tous les habitants de Jérusalem se rendaient auprès de lui; et, confessant leurs péchés, ils se faisaient baptiser par lui dans le fleuve du Jourdain.
verses.am: የይሁዳም አገር ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምም ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይወጡ ነበር፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም እየተናዘዙ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ከእርሱ ይጠመቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
verses.fr: Jean avait un vêtement de poils de chameau, et une ceinture de cuir autour des reins. Il se nourrissait de sauterelles et de miel sauvage.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም የግመል ጠጉር ለብሶ በወገቡ ጠፍር ይታጠቅ አንበጣና የበረሀ ማርም ይበላ ነበር።

verses.en: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
verses.fr: Il prêchait, disant: Il vient après moi celui qui est plus puissant que moi, et je ne suis pas digne de délier, en me baissant, la courroie de ses souliers.
verses.am: ተጎንብሼ የጫማውን ጠፍር መፍታት የማይገባኝ ከእኔ የሚበረታ በኋላዬ ይመጣል።

verses.en: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Moi, je vous ai baptisés d''eau; lui, il vous baptisera du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: እኔ በውኃ አጠመቅኋችሁ እርሱ ግን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ያጠምቃችኋል እያለ ይሰብክ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Jésus vint de Nazareth en Galilée, et il fut baptisé par Jean dans le Jourdain.
verses.am: በዚያ ወራትም ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ናዝሬት መጥቶ ከዮሐንስ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ተጠመቀ።

verses.en: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
verses.fr: Au moment où il sortait de l''eau, il vit les cieux s''ouvrir, et l''Esprit descendre sur lui comme une colombe.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ከውኃው በወጣ ጊዜ ሰማያት ሲቀደዱ መንፈስም እንደ ርግብ ሲወርድበት አየና። የምወድህ ልጄ አንተ ነህ፥

verses.en: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.fr: Et une voix fit entendre des cieux ces paroles: Tu es mon Fils bien-aimé, en toi j''ai mis toute mon affection.
verses.am: በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል የሚል ድምፅ ከሰማያት መጣ።

verses.en: And immediately the spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
verses.fr: Aussitôt, l''Esprit poussa Jésus dans le désert,
verses.am: ወዲያውም መንፈስ ወደ ምድረ በዳ አወጣው።

verses.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
verses.fr: où il passa quarante jours, tenté par Satan. Il était avec les bêtes sauvages, et les anges le servaient.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳም ከሰይጣን እየተፈተነ አርባ ቀን ሰነበተ ከአራዊትም ጋር ነበረ፥ መላእክቱም አገለገሉት።

verses.en: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
verses.fr: Après que Jean eut été livré, Jésus alla dans la Galilée, prêchant l''Evangile de Dieu.
verses.am: በገሊላ ባሕርም አጠገብ ሲያልፍ ስምዖንን ወንድሙንም እንድርያስን መረባቸውን ወደ ባሕር ሲጥሉ አየ፥ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ነበሩና።

verses.en: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
verses.fr: Il disait: Le temps est accompli, et le royaume de Dieu est proche. Repentez-vous, et croyez à la bonne nouvelle.
verses.am: በገሊላ ባሕርም አጠገብ ሲያልፍ ስምዖንን ወንድሙንም እንድርያስን መረባቸውን ወደ ባሕር ሲጥሉ አየ፥ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ነበሩና።

verses.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.fr: Comme il passait le long de la mer de Galilée, il vit Simon et André, frère de Simon, qui jetaient un filet dans la mer; car ils étaient pêcheurs.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። በኋላዬ ኑና ሰዎችን አጥማጆች እንድትሆኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Suivez-moi, et je vous ferai pêcheurs d''hommes.
verses.am: ወዲያውም መረባቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
verses.fr: Aussitôt, ils laissèrent leurs filets, et le suivirent.
verses.am: ከዚያም ጥቂት እልፍ ብሎ የዘብዴዎስን ልጅ ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ደግሞ በታንኳ ላይ መረባቸውን ሲያበጁ አየ።

verses.en: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
verses.fr: Etant allé un peu plus loin, il vit Jacques, fils de Zébédée, et Jean, son frère, qui, eux aussi, étaient dans une barque et réparaient les filets.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ጠራቸው አባታቸውንም ዘብዴዎስን ከሞያተኞቹ ጋር በታንኳ ላይ ትተው ተከትለውት ሄዱ።

verses.en: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.fr: Aussitôt, il les appela; et, laissant leur père Zébédée dans la barque avec les ouvriers, ils le suivirent.
verses.am: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም ገቡ፤ ወዲያውም በሰንበት ወደ ምኵራብ ገብቶ አስተማረ።

verses.en: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
verses.fr: Ils se rendirent à Capernaüm. Et, le jour du sabbat, Jésus entra d''abord dans la synagogue, et il enseigna.
verses.am: እንደ ባለ ሥልጣን ያስተምራቸው ነበር እንጂ እንደ ጻፎች አይደለምና በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.fr: Ils étaient frappés de sa doctrine; car il enseignait comme ayant autorité, et non pas comme les scribes.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም በምኩራባቸው ርኵስ መንፈስ ያለው ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
verses.fr: Il se trouva dans leur synagogue un homme qui avait un esprit impur, et qui s''écria:
verses.am: እርሱም። የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ልታጠፋን መጣህን? ማን እንደ ሆንህ አውቄአለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱሱ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
verses.fr: Qu''y a-t-il entre nous et toi, Jésus de Nazareth? Tu es venu pour nous perdre. Je sais qui tu es: le Saint de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ዝም በል ከእርሱም ውጣ ብሎ ገሠጸው።

verses.en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
verses.fr: Jésus le menaça, disant: Tais-toi, et sors de cet homme.
verses.am: ርኵሱም መንፈስ አንፈራገጠውና በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ ከእርሱ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
verses.fr: Et l''esprit impur sortit de cet homme, en l''agitant avec violence, et en poussant un grand cri.
verses.am: ሁሉም። ይህ ምንድር ነው? በሥልጣን ርኵሳን መናፍስትን ያዝዛል፤ እነርሱም ይታዘዙለታልና ይህ አዲስ ትምህርት ምንድር ነው? ብለው እስኪጠያየቁ ድረስ አደነቁ።

verses.en: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
verses.fr: Tous furent saisis de stupéfaction, de sorte qu''ils se demandaient les uns aux autres: Qu''est-ce que ceci? Une nouvelle doctrine! Il commande avec autorité même aux esprits impurs, et ils lui obéissent!
verses.am: ዝናውም ወዲያው በየስፍራው ወደ ገሊላ ዙሪያ ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
verses.fr: Et sa renommée se répandit aussitôt dans tous les lieux environnants de la Galilée.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ከምኵራብ ወጥቶ ከያዕቆብና ከዮሐንስ ጋር ወደ ስምዖንና ወደ እንድርያስ ቤት ገባ።

verses.en: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.fr: En sortant de la synagogue, ils se rendirent avec Jacques et Jean à la maison de Simon et d''André.
verses.am: የስምዖንም አማት በንዳድ ታማ ተኝታ ነበር፥ ስለ እርስዋም ወዲያው ነገሩት።

verses.en: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
verses.fr: La belle-mère de Simon était couchée, ayant la fièvre; et aussitôt on parla d''elle à Jésus.
verses.am: ቀርቦም እጅዋን ይዞ አስነሣት ንዳዱም ወዲያው ለቀቃትና አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.en: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
verses.fr: S''étant approché, il la fit lever en lui prenant la main, et à l''instant la fièvre la quitta. Puis elle les servit.
verses.am: ፀሐይም ገብቶ በመሸ ጊዜ፥ የታመሙትንና አጋንንት ያደረባቸውን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤

verses.en: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
verses.fr: Le soir, après le coucher du soleil, on lui amena tous les malades et les démoniaques.
verses.am: ከተማይቱም ሁላ በደጅ ተሰብስባ ነበር።

verses.en: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.fr: Et toute la ville était rassemblée devant sa porte.
verses.am: በልዩ ልዩ ደዌም የታመሙትን ብዙዎችን ፈወሰ፥ ብዙዎችንም አጋንንት አወጣ፥ አጋንንትም ክርስቶስ መሆኑን አውቀው ነበርና ሊናገሩ አልፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
verses.fr: Il guérit beaucoup de gens qui avaient diverses maladies; il chassa aussi beaucoup de démons, et il ne permettait pas aux démons de parler, parce qu''ils le connaissaient.
verses.am: ማለዳም ተነሥቶ ገና ሌሊት ሳለ ወጣ ወደ ምድረ በዳም ሄዶ በዚያ ጸለየ።

verses.en: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
verses.fr: Vers le matin, pendant qu''il faisait encore très sombre, il se leva, et sortit pour aller dans un lieu désert, où il pria.
verses.am: ስምዖንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም ገሥግሠው ተከተሉት፥

verses.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
verses.fr: Simon et ceux qui étaient avec lui se mirent à sa recherche;
verses.am: ባገኙትም ጊዜ። ሁሉ ይፈልጉሃል አሉት።

verses.en: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
verses.fr: et, quand ils l''eurent trouvé, ils lui dirent: Tous te cherchent.
verses.am: እርሱም። በዚያ ደግሞ ልሰብክ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ በቅርብ ወዳሉ መንደሮች እንሂድ ስለዚህ ወጥቻለሁና አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Allons ailleurs, dans les bourgades voisines, afin que j''y prêche aussi; car c''est pour cela que je suis sorti.
verses.am: በምኵራባቸውም እየሰበከ አጋንንትንም እያወጣ ወደ ገሊላ ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
verses.fr: Et il alla prêcher dans les synagogues, par toute la Galilée, et il chassa les démons.
verses.am: ለምጻምም ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ ተንበረከከና። ብትወድስ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.en: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.fr: Un lépreux vint à lui; et, se jetant à genoux, il lui dit d''un ton suppliant: Si tu le veux, tu peux me rendre pur.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አዘነለት እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወድዳለሁ፤ ንጻ አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
verses.fr: Jésus, ému de compassion, étendit la main, le toucha, et dit: Je le veux, sois pur.
verses.am: በተናገረም ጊዜ ለምጹ ወዲያው ለቀቀውና ነጻ።

verses.en: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
verses.fr: Aussitôt la lèpre le quitta, et il fut purifié.
verses.am: በብርቱም ተናግሮ ወዲያው አወጣው፤

verses.en: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
verses.fr: Jésus le renvoya sur-le-champ, avec de sévères recommandations,
verses.am: ለማንም አንዳች እንዳትናገር ተጠንቀቅ፥ ነገር ግን ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ስለ መንጻትህ ሙሴ ያዘዘውን አቅርብ አለው።

verses.en: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.fr: et lui dit: Garde-toi de rien dire à personne; mais va te montrer au sacrificateur, et offre pour ta purification ce que Moïse a prescrit, afin que cela leur serve de témoignage.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ሲወጣ ብዙ ሊሰብክና ነገሩን ሊያወራ ጀመረ፥ ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ ተገልጦ ወደ ከተማ መግባት ወደ ፊት ተሳነው፥ ነገር ግን በውጭ በምድረ በዳ ይኖር ነበር፤ ከየስፍራውም ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
verses.fr: Mais cet homme, s''en étant allé, se mit à publier hautement la chose et à la divulguer, de sorte que Jésus ne pouvait plus entrer publiquement dans une ville. Il se tenait dehors, dans des lieux déserts, et l''on venait à lui de toutes parts.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ሲወጣ ብዙ ሊሰብክና ነገሩን ሊያወራ ጀመረ፥ ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ ተገልጦ ወደ ከተማ መግባት ወደ ፊት ተሳነው፥ ነገር ግን በውጭ በምድረ በዳ ይኖር ነበር፤ ከየስፍራውም ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
verses.fr: Quelques jours après, Jésus revint à Capernaüm. On apprit qu''il était à la maison,
verses.am: ከጥቂት ቀን በኋላ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ደግሞ ገብቶ በቤት እንደ ሆነ ተሰማ።

verses.en: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
verses.fr: et il s''assembla un si grand nombre de personnes que l''espace devant la porte ne pouvait plus les contenir. Il leur annonçait la parole.
verses.am: በደጅ ያለው ስፍራም እስኪጠባቸው ድረስ ብዙ ሰዎች ተሰበሰቡ፤ ቃሉንም ይነግራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
verses.fr: Des gens vinrent à lui, amenant un paralytique porté par quatre hommes.
verses.am: አራት ሰዎችም የተሸከሙትን ሽባ አመጡለት።

verses.en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
verses.fr: Comme ils ne pouvaient l''aborder, à cause de la foule, ils découvrirent le toit de la maison où il était, et ils descendirent par cette ouverture le lit sur lequel le paralytique était couché.
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡም ብዛት ወደ እርሱ ማቅረብ ቢያቅታቸው እርሱ ያለበትን የቤቱን ጣራ አነሡ፥ ነድለውም ሽባው የተኛበትን አልጋ አወረዱ።

verses.en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant leur foi, dit au paralytique: Mon enfant, tes péchés sont pardonnés.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እምነታቸውን አይቶ ሽባውን። አንተ ልጅ፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.en: But there was certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.fr: Il y avait là quelques scribes, qui étaient assis, et qui se disaient au dedans d''eux:
verses.am: ከጻፎችም አንዳንዶቹ በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር በልባቸውም። ይህ ሰው ስለ ምን እንደዚህ ያለ ስድብ ይናገራል?

verses.en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
verses.fr: Comment cet homme parle-t-il ainsi? Il blasphème. Qui peut pardonner les péchés, si ce n''est Dieu seul?
verses.am: ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ማን ይችላል? ብለው አሰቡ።

verses.en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
verses.fr: Jésus, ayant aussitôt connu par son esprit ce qu''ils pensaient au dedans d''eux, leur dit: Pourquoi avez-vous de telles pensées dans vos coeurs?
verses.am: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ በልባቸው እንዲህ እንዳሰቡ በመንፈስ አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። በልባችሁ ይህን ስለ ምን ታስባላችሁ?

verses.en: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.fr: Lequel est le plus aisé, de dire au paralytique: Tes péchés sont pardonnés, ou de dire: Lève-toi, prends ton lit, et marche?
verses.am: ሽባውን። ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣ አልጋህንም ተሸከምና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
verses.fr: Or, afin que vous sachiez que le Fils de l''homme a sur la terre le pouvoir de pardonner les péchés:
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለሰው ልጅ በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ሊያስተሰርይ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ፤

verses.en: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
verses.fr: Je te l''ordonne, dit-il au paralytique, lève-toi, prends ton lit, et va dans ta maison.
verses.am: ሽባውን። አንተን እልሃለሁ፥ ተነሣ፥ አልጋህን ተሸከምና ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
verses.fr: Et, à l''instant, il se leva, prit son lit, et sortit en présence de tout le monde, de sorte qu''ils étaient tous dans l''étonnement et glorifiaient Dieu, disant: Nous n''avons jamais rien vu de pareil.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ወዲያው አልጋውን ተሸክሞ በሁሉ ፊት ወጣ፥ ስለዚህም ሰዎች ሁሉ ተገረሙና። እንዲህ ያለ ከቶ አላየንም ብለው እግዚአብሔርን አከበሩ።

verses.en: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
verses.fr: Jésus sortit de nouveau du côté de la mer. Toute la foule venait à lui, et il les enseignait.
verses.am: ደግሞም በባሕር አጠገብ ወጣ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡና አስተማራቸው።

verses.en: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
verses.fr: En passant, il vit Lévi, fils d''Alphée, assis au bureau des péages. Il lui dit: Suis-moi. Lévi se leva, et le suivit.
verses.am: ሲያልፍም በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ የነበረውን የእልፍዮስን ልጅ ሌዊን አየና። ተከተለኝ አለው። ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
verses.fr: Comme Jésus était à table dans la maison de Lévi, beaucoup de publicains et de gens de mauvaise vie se mirent aussi à table avec lui et avec ses disciples; car ils étaient nombreux, et l''avaient suivi.
verses.am: በቤቱም በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ ብዙ ቀራጮችና ኃጢአተኞች ከኢየሱስና ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተቀመጡ፤ ብዙ ነበሩ ይከተሉትም ነበር።

verses.en: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
verses.fr: Les scribes et les pharisiens, le voyant manger avec les publicains et les gens de mauvaise vie, dirent à ses disciples: Pourquoi mange-t-il et boit-il avec les publicains et les gens de mauvaise vie?
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ሲበላ አይተው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ከቀራ ጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር የሚበላና የሚጠጣ ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉ።

verses.en: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.fr: Ce que Jésus ayant entendu, il leur dit: Ce ne sont pas ceux qui se portent bien qui ont besoin de médecin, mais les malades. Je ne suis pas venu appeler des justes, mais des pécheurs.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ብርቱዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም ኃጢአተኞችን እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.fr: Les disciples de Jean et les pharisiens jeûnaient. Ils vinrent dire à Jésus: Pourquoi les disciples de Jean et ceux des pharisiens jeûnent-ils, tandis que tes disciples ne jeûnent point?
verses.am: የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርትና ፈሪሳውያን ይጦሙ ነበር። መጥተውም። የዮሐንስና የፈሪሳውያን ደቀ መዛሙርት የሚጦሙት የአንተ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን የማይጦሙት ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Les amis de l''époux peuvent-ils jeûner pendant que l''époux est avec eux? Aussi longtemps qu''ils ont avec eux l''époux, ils ne peuvent jeûner.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አላቸው። ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሚዜዎች ሊጦሙ ይችላሉን? ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሊጦሙ አይችሉም።

verses.en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.fr: Les jours viendront où l''époux leur sera enlevé, et alors ils jeûneront en ce jour-là.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ የሚወሰድበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ በዚያ ወራትም ይጦማሉ።

verses.en: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
verses.fr: Personne ne coud une pièce de drap neuf à un vieil habit; autrement, la pièce de drap neuf emporterait une partie du vieux, et la déchirure serait pire.
verses.am: በአረጀ ልብስ አዲስ እራፊ የሚጥፍ የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን፥ አዲሱ መጣፊያ አሮጌውን ይቦጭቀዋል፥ መቀደዱም የባሰ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
verses.fr: Et personne ne met du vin nouveau dans de vieilles outres; autrement, le vin fait rompre les outres, et le vin et les outres sont perdus; mais il faut mettre le vin nouveau dans des outres neuves.
verses.am: በአረጀ አቁማዳም አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን፥ የወይን ጠጁ አቁማዳውን ያፈነዳል የወይኑም ጠጅ ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ ግን በአዲስ አቁማዳ ያኖራሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
verses.fr: Il arriva, un jour de sabbat, que Jésus traversa des champs de blé. Ses disciples, chemin faisant, se mirent à arracher des épis.
verses.am: በሰንበትም በእርሻ መካከል ሲያልፍ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ እየሄዱ እሸት ይቀጥፉ ጀመር።

verses.en: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
verses.fr: Les pharisiens lui dirent: Voici, pourquoi font-ils ce qui n''est pas permis pendant le sabbat?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም። እነሆ፥ በሰንበት ያልተፈቀደውን ስለ ምን ያደርጋሉ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: N''avez-vous jamais lu ce que fit David, lorsqu''il fut dans la nécessité et qu''il eut faim, lui et ceux qui étaient avec lui;
verses.am: እርሱም። ዳዊት ባስፈለገውና በተራበ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ አብረውት ከነበሩት ጋር ያደረገውን፥ አብያተር ሊቀ ካህናት በነበረ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ፥

verses.en: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
verses.fr: comment il entra dans la maison de Dieu, du temps du souverain sacrificateur Abiathar, et mangea les pains de proposition, qu''il n''est permis qu''aux sacrificateurs de manger, et en donna même à ceux qui étaient avec lui!
verses.am: ከካህናት በቀር መብላት ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕትን እንጀራ እንደ በላ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ለነበሩት እንደ ሰጣቸው ከቶ አላነበባችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: Le sabbat a été fait pour l''homme, et non l''homme pour le sabbat,
verses.am: ደግሞ። ሰንበት ስለ ሰው ተፈጥሮአል እንጂ ሰው ስለ ሰንበት አልተፈጠረም፤

verses.en: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.fr: de sorte que le Fils de l''homme est maître même du sabbat.
verses.am: እንዲሁም የሰው ልጅ ለሰንበት እንኳ ጌታዋ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
verses.fr: Jésus entra de nouveau dans la synagogue. Il s''y trouvait un homme qui avait la main sèche.
verses.am: ደግሞም ወደ ምኵራብ ገባ፥ በዚያም እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበር፤

verses.en: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
verses.fr: Ils observaient Jésus, pour voir s''il le guérirait le jour du sabbat: c''était afin de pouvoir l''accuser.
verses.am: ሊከሱትም፥ በሰንበት ይፈውሰው እንደ ሆነ ይጠባበቁት ነበር።

verses.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
verses.fr: Et Jésus dit à l''homme qui avait la main sèche: Lève-toi, là au milieu.
verses.am: እጁ የሰለለችውንም ሰው። ተነሥተህ ወደ መካከል ና አለው።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: Est-il permis, le jour du sabbat, de faire du bien ou de faire du mal, de sauver une personne ou de la tuer? Mais ils gardèrent le silence.
verses.am: በሰንበት በጎ ማድረግ ተፈቅዶአልን? ወይስ ክፉ? ነፍስ ማዳን ወይስ መግደል? አላቸው፤ እነርሱም ዝም አሉ።

verses.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.fr: Alors, promenant ses regards sur eux avec indignation, et en même temps affligé de l''endurcissement de leur coeur, il dit à l''homme: Etends ta main. Il l''étendit, et sa main fut guérie.
verses.am: ስለ ልባቸውም ድንዛዜ አዝኖ ዙሪያውን እየተመለከተ በቍጣ አያቸው፥ ሰውየውንም። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው።

verses.en: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens sortirent, et aussitôt ils se consultèrent avec les hérodiens sur les moyens de le faire périr.
verses.am: ዘረጋትም፥ እጁም ዳነች። ፈሪሳውያንም ወጥተው ወዲያው እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያጠፉት ከሄሮድስ ወገን ጋር ተማከሩበት።

verses.en: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
verses.fr: Jésus se retira vers la mer avec ses disciples. Une grande multitude le suivit de la Galilée; et de la Judée,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ባህር ፈቀቅ አለ፤ ከገሊላ የመጡም ብዙ ሰዎች ተከተሉት፤

verses.en: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
verses.fr: et de Jérusalem, et de l''Idumée, et d''au delà du Jourdain, et des environs de Tyr et de Sidon, une grande multitude, apprenant tout ce qu''il faisait, vint à lui.
verses.am: እንዴት ትልቅ ነገርም እንዳደረገው ሰምተው ብዙ ሰዎች ከይሁዳ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከኤዶምያስም ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶም ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ምድርም ወደ እርሱ መጡ።

verses.en: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
verses.fr: Il chargea ses disciples de tenir toujours à sa disposition une petite barque, afin de ne pas être pressé par la foule.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም እንዳያጋፉት ታንኳን ያቆዩለት ዘንድ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን አዘዛቸው፤

verses.en: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
verses.fr: Car, comme il guérissait beaucoup de gens, tous ceux qui avaient des maladies se jetaient sur lui pour le toucher.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎችን አድኖ ነበርና፥ ስለዚህም ሥቃይ ያለባቸው ሁሉ እንዲዳስሱት ይወድቁበት ነበር።

verses.en: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
verses.fr: Les esprits impurs, quand ils le voyaient, se prosternaient devant lui, et s''écriaient: Tu es le Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: ርኵሳን መናፍስትም ባዩት ጊዜ በፊቱ ተደፍተው። አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.en: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
verses.fr: Mais il leur recommandait très sévèrement de ne pas le faire connaître.
verses.am: እንዳይገልጡትም በጣም አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
verses.fr: Il monta ensuite sur la montagne; il appela ceux qu''il voulut, et ils vinrent auprès de lui.
verses.am: ወደ ተራራም ወጣ፥ ራሱም የወደዳቸውን ወደ እርሱ ጠራ፥ ወደ እርሱም ሄዱ።

verses.en: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
verses.fr: Il en établit douze, pour les avoir avec lui, et pour les envoyer prêcher
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር እንዲኖሩና ለመስበክ እንዲልካቸው፥

verses.en: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
verses.fr: avec le pouvoir de chasser les démons.
verses.am: ድውዮችንም ሊፈውሱ አጋንንትንም ሊያወጡ ሥልጣን ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ አሥራ ሁለት አደረገ፤

verses.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
verses.fr: Voici les douze qu''il établit: Simon, qu''il nomma Pierre;
verses.am: ስምዖንንም ጴጥሮስ ብሎ ሰየመው፤

verses.en: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
verses.fr: Jacques, fils de Zébédée, et Jean, frère de Jacques, auxquels il donna le nom de Boanergès, qui signifie fils du tonnerre;
verses.am: የዘብዴዎስንም ልጅ ያዕቆብን የያዕቆብንም ወንድም ዮሐንስን ቦአኔርጌስ ብሎ ሰየማቸው፥ የነጎድጓድ ልጆች ማለት ነው፤

verses.en: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
verses.fr: André; Philippe; Barthélemy; Matthieu; Thomas; Jacques, fils d''Alphée; Thaddée; Simon le Cananite;
verses.am: እንድርያስንም ፊልጶስንም በርተሎሜውስንም ማቴዎስንም ቶማስንም የእልፍዮስን ልጅ ያዕቆብንም ታዴዎስንም ቀነናዊውንም ስምዖንን፥

verses.en: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
verses.fr: et Judas Iscariot, celui qui livra Jésus. Ils se rendirent à la maison,
verses.am: አሳልፎ የሰጠውንም የአስቆሮቱን ይሁዳን።

verses.en: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
verses.fr: et la foule s''assembla de nouveau, en sorte qu''ils ne pouvaient pas même prendre leur repas.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም መጡ፤ እንጀራም መብላት ስንኳ እስኪሳናቸው ድረስ እንደ ገና ብዙ ሰዎች ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
verses.fr: Les parents de Jésus, ayant appris ce qui se passait, vinrent pour se saisir de lui; car ils disaient: Il est hors de sens.
verses.am: ዘመዶቹም ሰምተው። አበደ ብለዋልና ሊይዙት ወጡ።

verses.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
verses.fr: Et les scribes, qui étaient descendus de Jérusalem, dirent: Il est possédé de Béelzébul; c''est par le prince des démons qu''il chasse les démons.
verses.am: ከኢየሩሳሌም የወረዱ ጻፎችም። ብዔል ዜቡል አለበት፤ ደግሞ። በአጋንንት አለቃ አጋንንትን ያወጣል ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.fr: Jésus les appela, et leur dit sous forme de paraboles: Comment Satan peut-il chasser Satan?
verses.am: እነርሱንም ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ በምሳሌ አላቸው። ሰይጣን ሰይጣንን ሊያወጣው እንዴት ይችላል?

verses.en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.fr: Si un royaume est divisé contre lui-même, ce royaume ne peut subsister;
verses.am: መንግሥትም እርስ በርስዋ ከተለያየች ያች መንግሥት ልትቆም አትችልም፤

verses.en: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
verses.fr: et si une maison est divisée contre elle-même, cette maison ne peut subsister.
verses.am: ቤትም እርስ በርሱ ከተለያየ ያ ቤት ሊቆም አይችልም።

verses.en: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
verses.fr: Si donc Satan se révolte contre lui-même, il est divisé, et il ne peut subsister, mais c''en est fait de lui.
verses.am: ሰይጣንም ራሱን ተቃውሞ ከተለያየ፥ መጨረሻ ይሆንበታል እንጂ ሊቆም አይችልም።

verses.en: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
verses.fr: Personne ne peut entrer dans la maison d''un homme fort et piller ses biens, sans avoir auparavant lié cet homme fort; alors il pillera sa maison.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አስቀድሞ ኃይለኛውን ሳያስር ወደ ኃይለኛው ቤት ገብቶ ዕቃውን ሊበዘብዝ የሚችል የለም፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ ቤቱን ይበዘብዛል።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, tous les péchés seront pardonnés aux fils des hommes, et les blasphèmes qu''ils auront proférés;
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ለሰው ልጆች ኃጢአት ሁሉ የሚሳደቡትም ስድብ ሁሉ ይሰረይላቸዋል፤

verses.en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation.
verses.fr: mais quiconque blasphémera contre le Saint-Esprit n''obtiendra jamais de pardon: il est coupable d''un péché éternel.
verses.am: በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ላይ የሚሳደብ ሁሉ ግን የዘላለም ኃጢአት ዕዳ ይሆንበታል እንጂ ለዘላለም አይሰረይለትም።

verses.en: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
verses.fr: Jésus parla ainsi parce qu''ils disaient: Il est possédé d''un esprit impur.
verses.am: ርኵስ መንፈስ አለበት ይሉ ነበርና።

verses.en: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
verses.fr: Survinrent sa mère et ses frères, qui, se tenant dehors, l''envoyèrent appeler.
verses.am: እናቱና ወንድሞቹም መጡ በውጭም ቆመው ወደ እርሱ ልከው አስጠሩት።

verses.en: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
verses.fr: La foule était assise autour de lui, et on lui dit: Voici, ta mère et tes frères sont dehors et te demandent.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎችም በዙሪያው ተቀምጠው ነበሩና። እነሆ፥ እናትህ ወንድሞችህም በውጭ ቆመው ይፈልጉሃል አሉት።

verses.en: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
verses.fr: Et il répondit: Qui est ma mère, et qui sont mes frères?
verses.am: መልሶም። እናቴ ማን ናት? ወንድሞቼስ እነ ማን ናቸው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.fr: Puis, jetant les regards sur ceux qui étaient assis tout autour de lui: Voici, dit-il, ma mère et mes frères.
verses.am: በዙሪያው ተቀምጠው ወደ ነበሩትም ተመለከተና። እነሆ እናቴ ወንድሞቼም።

verses.en: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
verses.fr: Car, quiconque fait la volonté de Dieu, celui-là est mon frère, ma soeur, et ma mère.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ ወንድሜ ነው እኅቴም እናቴም አለ።

verses.en: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
verses.fr: Jésus se mit de nouveau à enseigner au bord de la mer. Une grande foule s''étant assemblée auprès de lui, il monta et s''assit dans une barque, sur la mer. Toute la foule était à terre sur le rivage.
verses.am: ደግሞም በባሕር ዳር ሊያስተምር ጀመረ። እጅግ ብዙ ሰዎችም ወደ እርሱ ስለ ተሰበሰቡ እርሱ በታንኳ ገብቶ በባሕር ላይ ተቀመጠ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በባሕር ዳር በምድር ላይ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
verses.fr: Il leur enseigna beaucoup de choses en paraboles, et il leur dit dans son enseignement:
verses.am: በምሳሌም ብዙ ያስተምራቸው ነበር፥ በትምህርቱም አላቸው። ስሙ።

verses.en: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
verses.fr: Ecoutez. Un semeur sortit pour semer.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
verses.fr: Comme il semait, une partie de la semence tomba le long du chemin: les oiseaux vinrent, et la mangèrent.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ዘሪ ሊዘራ ወጣ። ሲዘራም አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀና ወፎች መጥተው በሉት።

verses.en: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba dans un endroit pierreux, où elle n''avait pas beaucoup de terre; elle leva aussitôt, parce qu''elle ne trouva pas un sol profond;
verses.am: ሌላውም ብዙ መሬት በሌለበት በጭንጫ ላይ ወደቀና ጥልቅ መሬት ስላልነበረው ወዲያው በቀለ፤

verses.en: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.fr: mais, quand le soleil parut, elle fut brûlée et sécha, faute de racines.
verses.am: ፀሐይም ሲወጣ ጠወለገ፥ ሥርም ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።

verses.en: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba parmi les épines: les épines montèrent, et l''étouffèrent, et elle ne donna point de fruit.
verses.am: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾህም ወጣና አነቀው፥ ፍሬም አልሰጠም።

verses.en: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba dans la bonne terre: elle donna du fruit qui montait et croissait, et elle rapporta trente, soixante, et cent pour un.
verses.am: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ላይ ወደቀና ወጥቶ አድጎ ፍሬ ሰጠ፥ አንዱም ሠላሳ አንዱም ስድሳ አንዱም መቶ አፈራ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.fr: Puis il dit: Que celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre entende.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ አለ።

verses.en: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut en particulier, ceux qui l''entouraient avec les douze l''interrogèrent sur les paraboles.
verses.am: ብቻውንም በሆነ ጊዜ፥ በዙሪያው የነበሩት ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ጋር ስለ ምሳሌው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
verses.fr: Il leur dit: C''est à vous qu''a été donné le mystère du royaume de Dieu; mais pour ceux qui sont dehors tout se passe en paraboles,
verses.am: አላቸውም። ይህን ምሳሌ አታውቁምን? እንዴትስ ምሳሌዎቹን ሁሉ ታውቃላችሁ?

verses.en: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
verses.fr: afin qu''en voyant ils voient et n''aperçoivent point, et qu''en entendant ils entendent et ne comprennent point, de peur qu''ils ne se convertissent, et que les péchés ne leur soient pardonnés.
verses.am: አላቸውም። ይህን ምሳሌ አታውቁምን? እንዴትስ ምሳሌዎቹን ሁሉ ታውቃላችሁ?

verses.en: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
verses.fr: Il leur dit encore: Vous ne comprenez pas cette parabole? Comment donc comprendrez-vous toutes les paraboles?
verses.am: ዘሪው ቃሉን ይዘራል። ቃልም በተዘራበት በመንገድ ዳር የሆኑት እነዚህ ናቸው፥

verses.en: The sower soweth the word.
verses.fr: Le semeur sème la parole.
verses.am: በሰሙት ጊዜም ሰይጣን ወዲያው መጥቶ በልባቸው የተዘራውን ቃል ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
verses.fr: Les uns sont le long du chemin, où la parole est semée; quand ils l''ont entendue, aussitôt Satan vient et enlève la parole qui a été semée en eux.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በጭንጫ ላይ የተዘሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ቃሉንም ሰምተው ወዲያው በደስታ ይቀበሉታል፥

verses.en: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
verses.fr: Les autres, pareillement, reçoivent la semence dans les endroits pierreux; quand ils entendent la parole, ils la reçoivent d''abord avec joie;
verses.am: ለጊዜውም ነው እንጂ በእነርሱ ሥር የላቸውም፥ ኋላም በቃሉ ምክንያት መከራ ወይም ስደት በሆነ ጊዜ ወዲያው ይሰናከላሉ።

verses.en: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.
verses.fr: mais ils n''ont pas de racine en eux-mêmes, ils manquent de persistance, et, dès que survient une tribulation ou une persécution à cause de la parole, ils y trouvent une occasion de chute.
verses.am: በእሾህም የተዘሩት ሌሎች ናቸው፥ ቃሉን የሰሙት እነዚህ ናቸው፥

verses.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
verses.fr: D''autres reçoivent la semence parmi les épines; ce sont ceux qui entendent la parole,
verses.am: የዚህም ዓለም አሳብና የባለጠግነት ማታለል የሌላውም ነገር ምኞት ገብተው ቃሉን ያንቃሉ፥ የማያፈራም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
verses.fr: mais en qui les soucis du siècle, la séduction des richesses et l''invasion des autres convoitises, étouffent la parole, et la rendent infructueuse.
verses.am: በመልካምም መሬት የተዘሩት ቃሉን ሰምተው የሚቀበሉት አንዱም ሠላሳ አንዱም ስድሳ አንዱም መቶ ፍሬ የሚያፈሩት እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.fr: D''autres reçoivent la semence dans la bonne terre; ce sont ceux qui entendent la parole, la reçoivent, et portent du fruit, trente, soixante, et cent pour un.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። መብራትን ከዕንቅብ ወይስ ከአልጋ በታች ሊያኖሩት ያመጡታልን? በመቅረዝ ላይ ሊያኖሩት አይደለምን?

verses.en: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
verses.fr: Il leur dit encore: Apporte-t-on la lampe pour la mettre sous le boisseau, ou sous le lit? N''est-ce pas pour la mettre sur le chandelier?
verses.am: እንዲገለጥ ባይሆን የተሰወረ የለምና፤ ወደ ግልጥ እንዲመጣ እንጂ የተሸሸገ የለም።

verses.en: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
verses.fr: Car il n''est rien de caché qui ne doive être découvert, rien de secret qui ne doive être mis au jour.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ቢኖር ይስማ።

verses.en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un a des oreilles pour entendre, qu''il entende.
verses.am: አላቸውም። ምን እንድትሰሙ ተጠበቁ። በምትሰፍሩበት መስፈሪያ ይሰፈርላችኋል ለእናንተም ይጨመርላችኋል።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
verses.fr: Il leur dit encore: Prenez garde à ce que vous entendez. On vous mesurera avec la mesure dont vous vous serez servis, et on y ajoutera pour vous.
verses.am: ላለው ይሰጠዋልና፤ ከሌለውም ያው ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.en: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
verses.fr: Car on donnera à celui qui a; mais à celui qui n''a pas on ôtera même ce qu''il a.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። በምድር ዘርን እንደሚዘራ ሰው የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደዚህ ናት ሌሊትና ቀን ይተኛልም ይነሣልም፥

verses.en: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
verses.fr: Il dit encore: Il en est du royaume de Dieu comme quand un homme jette de la semence en terre;
verses.am: እርሱም እንዴት እንደሚሆን ሳያውቅ ዘሩ ይበቅላል ያድግማል።

verses.en: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
verses.fr: qu''il dorme ou qu''il veille, nuit et jour, la semence germe et croît sans qu''il sache comment.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም አውቃ በመጀመሪያ ቡቃያ ኋላም ዛላ ኋላም በዛላው ፍጹም ሰብል ታፈራለች።

verses.en: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
verses.fr: La terre produit d''elle-même, d''abord l''herbe, puis l''épi, puis le grain tout formé dans l''épi;
verses.am: ፍሬ ግን ሲበስል መከር ደርሶአልና ወዲያው ማጭድ ይልካል።

verses.en: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
verses.fr: et, dès que le fruit est mûr, on y met la faucille, car la moisson est là.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት በምን እናስመስላታለን? ወይስ በምን ምሳሌ እንመስላታለን?

verses.en: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
verses.fr: Il dit encore: A quoi comparerons-nous le royaume de Dieu, ou par quelle parabole le représenterons-nous?
verses.am: እንደ ሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት ናት፥ እርስዋም በምድር በተዘራች ጊዜ በምድር ካለ ዘር ሁሉ ታንሳለች፤ በተዘራችም ጊዜ ትወጣለች ከአትክልትም ሁሉ የምትበልጥ ትሆናለች፥

verses.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
verses.fr: Il est semblable à un grain de sénevé, qui, lorsqu''on le sème en terre, est la plus petite de toutes les semences qui sont sur la terre;
verses.am: የሰማይ ወፎችም በጥላዋ ሊሰፍሩ እስኪችሉ ታላላቅ ቅርንጫፎች ታደርጋለች።

verses.en: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
verses.fr: mais, lorsqu''il a été semé, il monte, devient plus grand que tous les légumes, et pousse de grandes branches, en sorte que les oiseaux du ciel peuvent habiter sous son ombre.
verses.am: መስማትም በሚችሉበት መጠን እነዚህን በሚመስል በብዙ ምሳሌ ቃሉን ይነግራቸው ነበር፤ ያለ ምሳሌ ግን አልነገራቸውም፥

verses.en: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
verses.fr: C''est par beaucoup de paraboles de ce genre qu''il leur annonçait la parole, selon qu''ils étaient capables de l''entendre.
verses.am: ለብቻቸውም ሲሆኑ ነገሩን ሁሉ ለገዛ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይፈታላቸው ነበር።

verses.en: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
verses.fr: Il ne leur parlait point sans parabole; mais, en particulier, il expliquait tout à ses disciples.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ። ወደ ማዶ እንሻገር አላቸው።

verses.en: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
verses.fr: Ce même jour, sur le soir, Jésus leur dit: Passons à l''autre bord.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ትተው በታንኳ እንዲያው ወሰዱት፥ ሌሎች ታንኳዎችም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.en: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
verses.fr: Après avoir renvoyé la foule, ils l''emmenèrent dans la barque où il se trouvait; il y avait aussi d''autres barques avec lui.
verses.am: ብርቱ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ተነሣና ውኃ በታንኳይቱ እስኪሞላ ድረስ ማዕበሉ በታንኳይቱ ይገባ ነበር።

verses.en: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
verses.fr: Il s''éleva un grand tourbillon, et les flots se jetaient dans la barque, au point qu''elle se remplissait déjà.
verses.am: እርሱም በስተኋላዋ ትራስ ተንተርሶ ተኝቶ ነበር፤ አንቅተውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ስንጠፋ አይገድህምን? አሉት።

verses.en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
verses.fr: Et lui, il dormait à la poupe sur le coussin. Ils le réveillèrent, et lui dirent: Maître, ne t''inquiètes-tu pas de ce que nous périssons?
verses.am: ነቅቶም ነፋሱን ገሠጸው ባሕሩንም። ዝም በል፥ ፀጥ በል አለው። ነፋሱም ተወ ታላቅ ፀጥታም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
verses.fr: S''étant réveillé, il menaça le vent, et dit à la mer: Silence! tais-toi! Et le vent cessa, et il y eut un grand calme.
verses.am: እንዲህ የምትፈሩ ስለ ምን ነው? እንዴትስ እምነት የላችሁም? አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: Pourquoi avez-vous ainsi peur? Comment n''avez-vous point de foi?
verses.am: እጅግም ፈሩና። እንግዲህ ነፋስም ባሕርም የሚታዘዙለት ይህ ማን ነው? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
verses.fr: Ils furent saisis d''une grande frayeur, et ils se dirent les uns aux autres: Quel est donc celui-ci, à qui obéissent même le vent et la mer?
verses.am: እጅግም ፈሩና። እንግዲህ ነፋስም ባሕርም የሚታዘዙለት ይህ ማን ነው? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à l''autre bord de la mer, dans le pays des Gadaréniens.
verses.am: ወደ ባሕር ማዶም ወደ ጌርጌሴኖን አገር መጡ።

verses.en: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.fr: Aussitôt que Jésus fut hors de la barque, il vint au-devant de lui un homme, sortant des sépulcres, et possédé d''un esprit impur.
verses.am: ከታንኳይቱም በወጣ ጊዜ፥ ርኵስ መንፈስ የያዘው ሰው ከመቃብር ወጥቶ ወዲያው ተገናኘው፤

verses.en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
verses.fr: Cet homme avait sa demeure dans les sépulcres, et personne ne pouvait plus le lier, même avec une chaîne.
verses.am: እርሱም በመቃብር ይኖር ነበር፥ በሰንሰለትም ስንኳ ማንም ሊያስረው በዚያን ጊዜ አይችልም ነበር፤

verses.en: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
verses.fr: Car souvent il avait eu les fers aux pieds et avait été lié de chaînes, mais il avait rompu les chaînes et brisé les fers, et personne n''avait la force de le dompter.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በእግር ብረትና በሰንሰለት ይታሰር ነበርና ዳሩ ግን ሰንሰለቱን ይበጣጥስ እግር ብረቱንም ይሰባብር ነበር፥ ሊያሸንፈውም የሚችል አልነበረም፤

verses.en: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
verses.fr: Il était sans cesse, nuit et jour, dans les sépulcres et sur les montagnes, criant, et se meurtrissant avec des pierres.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜም ሌሊትና ቀን በመቃብርና በተራራ ሆኖ ይጮኽ ነበር ሰውነቱንም በድንጋይ ይቧጭር ነበር።

verses.en: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
verses.fr: Ayant vu Jésus de loin, il accourut, se prosterna devant lui,
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም ከሩቅ ባየ ጊዜ ሮጦ ሰገደለት፥

verses.en: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
verses.fr: et s''écria d''une voix forte: Qu''y a-t-il entre moi et toi, Jésus, Fils du Dieu Très-Haut? Je t''en conjure au nom de Dieu, ne me tourmente pas.
verses.am: በታላቅ ድምፅም እየጮኸ። የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? እንዳታሠቃየኝ በእግዚአብሔር አምልሃለሁ አለ፤

verses.en: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
verses.fr: Car Jésus lui disait: Sors de cet homme, esprit impur!
verses.am: አንተ ርኵስ መንፈስ፥ ከዚህ ሰው ውጣ ብሎት ነበርና።

verses.en: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
verses.fr: Et, il lui demanda: Quel est ton nom? Légion est mon nom, lui répondit-il, car nous sommes plusieurs.
verses.am: ስምህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው። ብዙዎች ነንና ስሜ ሌጌዎን ነው አለው፥

verses.en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
verses.fr: Et il le priait instamment de ne pas les envoyer hors du pays.
verses.am: ከአገርም ውጭ እንዳይሰዳቸው አጥብቆ ለመነው።

verses.en: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
verses.fr: Il y avait là, vers la montagne, un grand troupeau de pourceaux qui paissaient.
verses.am: በዚያም በተራራ ጥግ ብዙ የእሪያ መንጋ ይሰማራ ነበርና።

verses.en: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
verses.fr: Et les démons le prièrent, disant: Envoie-nous dans ces pourceaux, afin que nous entrions en eux.
verses.am: ወደ እሪያዎቹ እንድንገባ ስደደን ብለው ለመኑት።

verses.en: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
verses.fr: Il le leur permit. Et les esprits impurs sortirent, entrèrent dans les pourceaux, et le troupeau se précipita des pentes escarpées dans la mer: il y en avait environ deux mille, et ils se noyèrent dans la mer.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ፈቀደላቸው። ርኵሳን መናፍስቱም ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎቹ ገቡ፥ ሁለት ሺህም የሚያህል መንጋ ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር ተጣደፉና በባሕር ሰጠሙ።  ፍ1 ሌጌዎን ማለት ጭፍራ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
verses.fr: Ceux qui les faisaient paître s''enfuirent, et répandirent la nouvelle dans la ville et dans les campagnes. Les gens allèrent voir ce qui était arrivé.
verses.am: እረኞቹም ሸሽተው በከተማውና በአገሩ አወሩ፤ ነገሩም ምን እንደ ሆነ ለማየት መጡ።

verses.en: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.fr: Ils vinrent auprès de Jésus, et ils virent le démoniaque, celui qui avait eu la légion, assis, vêtu, et dans son bon sens; et ils furent saisis de frayeur.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሱስም መጡ፥ አጋንንትም ያደሩበትን ሌጌዎንም የነበረበትን ሰው ተቀምጦ ለብሶም ልቡም ተመልሶ አዩና ፈሩ።

verses.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient vu ce qui s''était passé leur racontèrent ce qui était arrivé au démoniaque et aux pourceaux.
verses.am: ያዩት ሰዎችም አጋንንት ላደሩበት ሰው የሆነውንና ስለ እሪያዎቹ ተረኩላቸው።

verses.en: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
verses.fr: Alors ils se mirent à supplier Jésus de quitter leur territoire.
verses.am: ከአገራቸውም እንዲሄድላቸው ይለምኑት ጀመር።

verses.en: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
verses.fr: Comme il montait dans la barque, celui qui avait été démoniaque lui demanda la permission de rester avec lui.
verses.am: ወደ ታንኳይቱም በገባ ጊዜ አጋንንት አድረውበት የነበረው ሰው ከእርሱ ጋር እንዲኖር ለመነው።

verses.en: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
verses.fr: Jésus ne le lui permit pas, mais il lui dit: Va dans ta maison, vers les tiens, et raconte-leur tout ce que le Seigneur t''a fait, et comment il a eu pitié de toi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አልፈቀደለትም፥ ነገር ግን። ወደ ቤትህ በቤተ ሰዎችህ ዘንድ ሄደህ ጌታ እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረገልህ እንዴትስ እንደ ማረህ አውራላቸው አለው።

verses.en: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
verses.fr: Il s''en alla, et se mit à publier dans la Décapole tout ce que Jésus avait fait pour lui. Et tous furent dans l''étonnement.
verses.am: ሄዶም ኢየሱስ እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረገለት አሥር ከተማ በሚባል አገር ይሰብክ ጀመር፥ ሁሉም ተደነቁ።

verses.en: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
verses.fr: Jésus dans la barque regagna l''autre rive, où une grande foule s''assembla près de lui. Il était au bord de la mer.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ በታንኳይቱ ወደ ማዶ ከተሻገረ በኋላ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፥ በባሕርም አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
verses.fr: Alors vint un des chefs de la synagogue, nommé Jaïrus, qui, l''ayant aperçu, se jeta à ses pieds,
verses.am: ኢያኢሮስ የተባለ ከምኵራብ አለቆች አንዱ መጣ፤ ባየውም ጊዜ በእግሩ ላይ ወደቀና።

verses.en: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
verses.fr: et lui adressa cette instante prière: Ma petite fille est à l''extrémité, viens, impose-lui les mains, afin qu''elle soit sauvée et qu''elle vive.
verses.am: ታናሽቱ ልጄ ልትሞት ቀርባለችና እንድትድንና በሕይወት እንድትኖር መጥተህ እጅህን ጫንባት ብሎ አጥብቆ ለመነው።

verses.en: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
verses.fr: Jésus s''en alla avec lui. Et une grande foule le suivait et le pressait.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ሄደ። ብዙ ሕዝብም ተከተሉት አጋፉትም።

verses.en: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
verses.fr: Or, il y avait une femme atteinte d''une perte de sang depuis douze ans.
verses.am: ከአሥራ ሁለት ዓመትም ጀምሮ ደም የሚፈሳት ሴት ነበረች፥

verses.en: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
verses.fr: Elle avait beaucoup souffert entre les mains de plusieurs médecins, elle avait dépensé tout ce qu''elle possédait, et elle n''avait éprouvé aucun soulagement, mais était allée plutôt en empirant.
verses.am: ከብዙ ባለ መድኃኒቶችም ብዙ ተሠቃየች፤ ገንዘብዋንም ሁሉ ከስራ ባሰባት እንጂ ምንም አልተጠቀመችም፤

verses.en: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
verses.fr: Ayant entendu parler de Jésus, elle vint dans la foule par derrière, et toucha son vêtement.
verses.am: የኢየሱስንም ወሬ ሰምታ በስተኋላው በሰዎች መካከል መጥታ ልብሱን ዳሰሰች።

verses.en: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
verses.fr: Car elle disait: Si je puis seulement toucher ses vêtements, je serai guérie.
verses.am: ልብሱን ብቻ የዳሰስሁ እንደ ሆነ እድናለሁ ብላለችና።

verses.en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
verses.fr: Au même instant la perte de sang s''arrêta, et elle sentit dans son corps qu''elle était guérie de son mal.
verses.am: ወዲያውም የደምዋ ምንጭ ደረቀ ከሥቃይዋም እንደዳነች በሰውነትዋ አወቀች።

verses.en: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
verses.fr: Jésus connut aussitôt en lui-même qu''une force était sortie de lui; et, se retournant au milieu de la foule, il dit: Qui a touché mes vêtements?
verses.am: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ ከእርሱ ኃይል እንደ ወጣ በገዛ ራሱ አውቆ በሕዝቡ መካከል ዘወር ብሎ። ልብሴን የዳሰሰ ማን ነው? አለ።

verses.en: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.fr: Ses disciples lui dirent: Tu vois la foule qui te presse, et tu dis: Qui m''a touché?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ሕዝቡ ሲያጋፉህ እያየህ። ማን ዳሰሰኝ ትላለህን? አሉት።

verses.en: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
verses.fr: Et il regardait autour de lui, pour voir celle qui avait fait cela.
verses.am: ይህንም ያደረገችውን ለማየት ዘወር ብሎ ይመለከት ነበር።

verses.en: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
verses.fr: La femme, effrayée et tremblante, sachant ce qui s''était passé en elle, vint se jeter à ses pieds, et lui dit toute la vérité.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ ግን የተደረገላትን ስላወቀች፥ እየፈራች እየተንቀጠቀጠችም፥ መጥታ በፊቱ ተደፋች እውነቱንም ሁሉ ነገረችው።

verses.en: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus lui dit: Ma fille, ta foi t''a sauvée; va en paix, et sois guérie de ton mal.
verses.am: እርሱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ ከሥቃይሽም ተፈወሽ አላት።

verses.en: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
verses.fr: Comme il parlait encore, survinrent de chez le chef de la synagogue des gens qui dirent: Ta fille est morte; pourquoi importuner davantage le maître?
verses.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ከምኵራብ አለቃው ቤት ዘንድ የመጡት። ልጅህ ሞታለች፤ ስለ ምን መምህሩን አሁን ታደክመዋለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, sans tenir compte de ces paroles, dit au chef de la synagogue: Ne crains pas, crois seulement.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን የተናገሩትን ቃል አድምጦ ለምኵራቡ አለቃ። እመን ብቻ እንጂ አትፍራ አለው።

verses.en: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
verses.fr: Et il ne permit à personne de l''accompagner, si ce n''est à Pierre, à Jacques, et à Jean, frère de Jacques.
verses.am: ከጴጥሮስም ከያዕቆብም ከያዕቆብም ወንድም ከዮሐንስ በቀር ማንም እንዲከተለው አልፈቀደም።

verses.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à la maison du chef de la synagogue, où Jésus vit une foule bruyante et des gens qui pleuraient et poussaient de grands cris.
verses.am: ወደ ምኵራቡ አለቃ ቤትም መጥቶ ሰዎች ሲንጫጩና ሲያለቅሱ ዋይታም ሲያበዙ አየ፤

verses.en: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.fr: Il entra, et leur dit: Pourquoi faites-vous du bruit, et pourquoi pleurez-vous? L''enfant n''est pas morte, mais elle dort.
verses.am: ገብቶም። ስለ ምን ትንጫጫላችሁ ታለቅሳላችሁም? ብላቴናይቱ ተኝታለች እንጂ አልሞተችም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
verses.fr: Et ils se moquaient de lui. Alors, ayant fait sortir tout le monde, il prit avec lui le père et la mère de l''enfant, et ceux qui l''avaient accompagné, et il entra là où était l''enfant.
verses.am: በጣምም ሳቁበት። እርሱ ግን ሁሉን አስወጥቶ የብላቴናይቱን አባትና እናትም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትንም ይዞ ብላቴናይቱ ወዳለችበት ገባ።

verses.en: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
verses.fr: Il la saisit par la main, et lui dit: Talitha koumi, ce qui signifie: Jeune fille, lève-toi, je te le dis.
verses.am: የብላቴናይቱንም እጅ ይዞ። ጣሊታ ቁሚ አላት፤ ፍችውም አንቺ ብላቴና ተነሽ እልሻለሁ ነው።

verses.en: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
verses.fr: Aussitôt la jeune fille se leva, et se mit à marcher; car elle avait douze ans. Et ils furent dans un grand étonnement.
verses.am: ብላቴናይቱም የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረችና ወዲያው ቆማ ተመላለሰች። ወዲያውም ታላቅ መገረም ተገረሙ።

verses.en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
verses.fr: Jésus leur adressa de fortes recommandations, pour que personne ne sût la chose; et il dit qu''on donnât à manger à la jeune fille.
verses.am: ይህንም ማንም እንዳያውቅ አጥብቆ አዞአቸው። የምትበላውን ስጡአት አላቸው።

verses.en: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
verses.fr: Jésus partit de là, et se rendit dans sa patrie. Ses disciples le suivirent.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወጥቶ ወደ ገዛ አገሩ መጣ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
verses.fr: Quand le sabbat fut venu, il se mit à enseigner dans la synagogue. Beaucoup de gens qui l''entendirent étaient étonnés et disaient: D''où lui viennent ces choses? Quelle est cette sagesse qui lui a été donnée, et comment de tels miracles se font-ils par ses mains?
verses.am: ሰንበትም በሆነ ጊዜ በምኵራብ ያስተምር ጀመር፤ ብዙዎችም ሰምተው ተገረሙና። እነዚህን ነገሮች ይህ ከወዴት አገኛቸው? ለዚህ የተሰጠችው ጥበብ ምንድር ናት? በእጁም የሚደረጉ እንደነዚህ ያሉ ተአምራት ምንድር ናቸው?

verses.en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas le charpentier, le fils de Marie, le frère de Jacques, de Joses, de Jude et de Simon? et ses soeurs ne sont-elles pas ici parmi nous? Et il était pour eux une occasion de chute.
verses.am: ይህስ ጸራቢው የማርያም ልጅ የያቆብም የዮሳም የይሁዳም የስምዖንም ወንድም አይደለምን? እኅቶቹስ በዚህ በእኛ ዘንድ አይደሉምን? አሉ፤ ይሰናከሉበትም ነበር።

verses.en: But Jesus, said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus leur dit: Un prophète n''est méprisé que dans sa patrie, parmi ses parents, et dans sa maison.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ነቢይ ከገዛ አገሩና ከገዛ ዘመዶቹ ከገዛ ቤቱም በቀር ሳይከበር አይቀርም አላቸው።

verses.en: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
verses.fr: Il ne put faire là aucun miracle, si ce n''est qu''il imposa les mains à quelques malades et les guérit.
verses.am: በዚያም በጥቂቶች ድውዮች ላይ እጁን ጭኖ ከመፈወስ በቀር፥ ተአምር ሊያደርግ ምንም አልቻለም።

verses.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
verses.fr: Et il s''étonnait de leur incrédulité. Jésus parcourait les villages d''alentour, en enseignant.
verses.am: ስለ አለማመናቸውም ተደነቀ። በመንደሮችም እያስተማረ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.en: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
verses.fr: Alors il appela les douze, et il commença à les envoyer deux à deux, en leur donnant pouvoir sur les esprits impurs.
verses.am: አስራ ሁለቱንም ወደ እርሱ ጠራ ሁለት ሁለቱንም ይልካቸው ጀመር፥ በርኵሳን መናፍስትም ላይ ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው፥

verses.en: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
verses.fr: Il leur prescrivit de ne rien prendre pour le voyage, si ce n''est un bâton; de n''avoir ni pain, ni sac, ni monnaie dans la ceinture;
verses.am: ለመንገድም ከበትር በቀር እንጀራም ቢሆን ከረጢትም ቢሆን መሐለቅም በመቀነታቸው ቢሆን እንዳይዙ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
verses.fr: de chausser des sandales, et de ne pas revêtir deux tuniques.
verses.am: በእግራችሁ ጫማ አድርጉ እንጂ ሁለት እጀ ጠባብ አትልበሱ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: Dans quelque maison que vous entriez, restez-y jusqu''à ce que vous partiez de ce lieu.
verses.am: በማናቸውም ስፍራ ወደ ቤት ብትገቡ ከዚያ እስክትወጡ ድረስ በዚያው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.fr: Et, s''il y a quelque part des gens qui ne vous reçoivent ni ne vous écoutent, retirez-vous de là, et secouez la poussière de vos pieds, afin que cela leur serve de témoignage.
verses.am: ከማይቀበሉአችሁና ከማይሰሙአችሁ ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ ከዚያ ወጥታችሁ ምስክር ይሆንባቸው ዘንድ ከእግራችሁ በታች ያለውን ትቢያ አራግፉ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚያች ከተማ ይልቅ ለሰዶምና ለገሞራ በፍርድ ቀን ይቀልላቸዋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
verses.fr: Ils partirent, et ils prêchèrent la repentance.
verses.am: ወጥተውም ንስሐ እንዲገቡ ሰበኩ፥ ብዙ አጋንንትንም አወጡ፥

verses.en: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
verses.fr: Ils chassaient beaucoup de démons, et ils oignaient d''huile beaucoup de malades et les guérissaient.
verses.am: ብዙ ድውዮችንም ዘይት እየቀቡ ፈወሱአቸው።

verses.en: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.fr: Le roi Hérode entendit parler de Jésus, dont le nom était devenu célèbre, et il dit: Jean Baptiste est ressuscité des morts, et c''est pour cela qu''il se fait par lui des miracles.
verses.am: ስሙም ተገልጦአልና ንጉሡ ሄሮድስ በሰማ ጊዜ። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል ስለዚህም ኃይል በእርሱ ይደረጋል አለ።

verses.en: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
verses.fr: D''autres disaient: C''est Elie. Et d''autres disaient: C''est un prophète comme l''un des prophètes.
verses.am: ሌሎችም። ኤልያስ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎችም። ከነቢያት እንደ አንዱ ነቢይ ነው አሉ።

verses.en: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
verses.fr: Mais Hérode, en apprenant cela, disait: Ce Jean que j''ai fait décapiter, c''est lui qui est ressuscité.
verses.am: ሄሮድስ ግን ሰምቶ። እኔ ራሱን ያስቈረጥሁት ዮሐንስ ይህ ነው እርሱ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል አለ።

verses.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
verses.fr: Car Hérode lui-même avait fait arrêter Jean, et l''avait fait lier en prison, à cause d''Hérodias, femme de Philippe, son frère, parce qu''il l''avait épousée,
verses.am: ሄሮድስ የወንድሙን የፊልጶስን ሚስት ሄሮድያዳን አግብቶ ነበርና በእርስዋ ምክንያት ራሱ ልኮ ዮሐንስን አስይዞ በወኅኒ አሳስሮት ነበር፤

verses.en: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
verses.fr: et que Jean lui disait: Il ne t''est pas permis d''avoir la femme de ton frère.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ሄሮድስን። የወንድምህ ሚስት ለአንተ ልትሆን አልተፈቀደም ይለው ነበርና።

verses.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
verses.fr: Hérodias était irritée contre Jean, et voulait le faire mourir. Mais elle ne le pouvait;
verses.am: ሄሮድያዳ ግን ተቃውማው ልትገድለው ትፈልግ ነበር አልቻለችም፤

verses.en: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
verses.fr: car Hérode craignait Jean, le connaissant pour un homme juste et saint; il le protégeait, et, après l''avoir entendu, il était souvent perplexe, et l''écoutait avec plaisir.
verses.am: ሄሮድስ ዮሐንስ ጻድቅና ቅዱስ ሰው እንደ ሆነ አውቆ ይፈራውና ይጠባበቀው ነበር፤ እርሱንም ሰምቶ በብዙ ነገር ያመነታ ነበር፤

verses.en: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
verses.fr: Cependant, un jour propice arriva, lorsque Hérode, à l''anniversaire de sa naissance, donna un festin à ses grands, aux chefs militaires et aux principaux de la Galilée.
verses.am: በደስታም ይሰማው ነበር። ሄሮድስም በተወለደበት ቀን ለመኳንንቱና ለሻለቆቹ ለገሊላም ሹማምንት ግብር ባደረገ ጊዜ ምቹ ቀን ሆነላትና

verses.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
verses.fr: La fille d''Hérodias entra dans la salle; elle dansa, et plut à Hérode et à ses convives. Le roi dit à la jeune fille: Demande-moi ce que tu voudras, et je te le donnerai.
verses.am: የሄሮድያዳ ልጅ ገብታ ስትዘፍን ሄሮድስንና ከእርሱ ጋር የተቀመጡትን ደስ አሰኘቻቸው። ንጉሡም ብላቴናይቱን። የምትወጂውን ሁሉ ለምኚኝ እሰጥሽማለሁ አላት፤

verses.en: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
verses.fr: Il ajouta avec serment: Ce que tu me demanderas, je te le donnerai, fût-ce la moitié de mon royaume.
verses.am: የመንግሥቴ እኩሌታ ስንኳ ቢሆን የምትለምኚውን ሁሉ እሰጥሻለሁ ብሎ ማለላት።

verses.en: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
verses.fr: Etant sortie, elle dit à sa mère: Que demanderai-je? Et sa mère répondit: La tête de Jean Baptiste.
verses.am: ወጥታም ለእናትዋ። ምን ልለምነው? አለች። እርስዋም። የመጥምቁን የዮሐንስን ራስ አለች።

verses.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
verses.fr: Elle s''empressa de rentrer aussitôt vers le roi, et lui fit cette demande: Je veux que tu me donnes à l''instant, sur un plat, la tête de Jean Baptiste.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ፈጥና ወደ ንጉሡ ገብታ። የመጥምቁን የዮሐንስን ራስ በወጭት አሁን ልትሰጠኝ እወዳለሁ ብላ ለመነችው።

verses.en: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
verses.fr: Le roi fut attristé; mais, à cause de ses serments et des convives, il ne voulut pas lui faire un refus.
verses.am: ንጉሡም እጅግ አዝኖ ስለ መሐላው ከእርሱም ጋር ስለ ተቀመጡት ሊነሣት አልወደደም።

verses.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.fr: Il envoya sur-le-champ un garde, avec ordre d''apporter la tête de Jean Baptiste. Le garde alla décapiter Jean dans la prison,
verses.am: ወዲያውም ንጉሡ ባለ ወግ ልኮ ራሱን እንዲያመጣ አዘዘው። ሄዶም በወኅኒ ራሱን ቈረጠ፥

verses.en: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
verses.fr: et apporta la tête sur un plat. Il la donna à la jeune fille, et la jeune fille la donna à sa mère.
verses.am: ራሱንም በወጭት አምጥቶ ለብላቴናይቱ ሰጣት፥ ብላቴናይቱም ለእናትዋ ሰጠች።

verses.en: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.fr: Les disciples de Jean, ayant appris cela, vinrent prendre son corps, et le mirent dans un sépulcre.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው መጡ በድኑንም ወስደው ቀበሩት።

verses.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
verses.fr: Les apôtres, s''étant rassemblés auprès de Jésus, lui racontèrent tout ce qu''ils avaient fait et tout ce qu''ils avaient enseigné.
verses.am: ሐዋርያትም ወደ ኢየሱስ ተሰብስበው ያደረጉትንና ያስተማሩትን ሁሉ ነገሩት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Venez à l''écart dans un lieu désert, et reposez-vous un peu. Car il y avait beaucoup d''allants et de venants, et ils n''avaient même pas le temps de manger.
verses.am: እናንት ራሳችሁ ብቻችሁን ወደ ምድረ በዳ ኑና ጥቂት ዕረፉ አላቸው፤ የሚመጡና የሚሄዱ ብዙዎች ነበሩና፥ ለመብላት እንኳ ጊዜ አጡ።

verses.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
verses.fr: Ils partirent donc dans une barque, pour aller à l''écart dans un lieu désert.
verses.am: በታንኳውም ብቻቸውን ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de gens les virent s''en aller et les reconnurent, et de toutes les villes on accourut à pied et on les devança au lieu où ils se rendaient.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ሲሄዱ አዩአቸው ብዙዎችም አወቁአቸውና ከከተሞች ሁሉ በእግር እየሮጡ ወዲያ ቀደሙአቸው ወደ እርሱም ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.fr: Quand il sortit de la barque, Jésus vit une grande foule, et fut ému de compassion pour eux, parce qu''ils étaient comme des brebis qui n''ont point de berger; et il se mit à leur enseigner beaucoup de choses.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወጥቶ ብዙ ሕዝብ አየና እረኛ እንደሌላቸው በጎች ስለ ነበሩ አዘነላቸው፥ ብዙም ነገር ያስተምራቸው ጀመር።

verses.en: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
verses.fr: Comme l''heure était déjà avancée, ses disciples s''approchèrent de lui, et dirent: Ce lieu est désert, et l''heure est déjà avancée;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙ ሰዓት ካለፈ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። ቦታው ምድረ በዳ ነው አሁንም መሽቶአል፤

verses.en: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
verses.fr: renvoie-les, afin qu''ils aillent dans les campagnes et dans les villages des environs, pour s''acheter de quoi manger.
verses.am: የሚበሉት የላቸውምና በዙሪያ ወዳሉ ገጠሮችና መንደሮች ሄደው እንጀራ ለራሳቸው እንዲገዙ አሰናብታቸው አሉት።

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Donnez-leur vous-mêmes à manger. Mais ils lui dirent: Irions-nous acheter des pains pour deux cents deniers, et leur donnerions-nous à manger?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። እናንተ የሚበሉትን ስጡአቸው አላቸው። ሄደን እንጀራ በሁለት መቶ ዲናር እንግዛላቸውን? እንዲበሉም እንስጣቸውን? አሉት።

verses.en: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Combien avez-vous de pains? Allez voir. Ils s''en assurèrent, et répondirent: Cinq, et deux poissons.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስንት እንጀራ አላችሁ? ሂዱና እዩ አላቸው። ባወቁም ጊዜ። አምስት፥ ሁለትም ዓሣ አሉት።

verses.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.fr: Alors il leur commanda de les faire tous asseoir par groupes sur l''herbe verte,
verses.am: ሁሉንም በየክፍሉ በለመለመ ሣር ላይ እንዲያስቀምጡአቸው አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
verses.fr: et ils s''assirent par rangées de cent et de cinquante.
verses.am: መቶ መቶውና አምሳ አምሳው እየሆኑ በተራ በተራ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
verses.fr: Il prit les cinq pains et les deux poissons et, levant les yeux vers le ciel, il rendit grâces. Puis, il rompit les pains, et les donna aux disciples, afin qu''ils les distribuassent à la foule. Il partagea aussi les deux poissons entre tous.
verses.am: አምስቱንም እንጀራ ሁለቱንም ዓሣ ይዞ ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ አየና ባረከ፥ እንጀራውንም ቈርሶ እንዲያቀርቡላቸው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥

verses.en: And they did all eat, and were filled.
verses.fr: Tous mangèrent et furent rassasiés,
verses.am: ሁለቱን ዓሣ ደግሞ ለሁሉ ከፈለ። ሁሉም በልተው ጠገቡ፤

verses.en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
verses.fr: et l''on emporta douze paniers pleins de morceaux de pain et de ce qui restait des poissons.
verses.am: ከቍርስራሹም አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ የሞላ አነሡ ከዓሣውም ደግሞ።

verses.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient mangé les pains étaient cinq mille hommes.
verses.am: እንጀራውንም የበሉት ወንዶቹ አምስት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
verses.fr: Aussitôt après, il obligea ses disciples à monter dans la barque et à passer avant lui de l''autre côté, vers Bethsaïda, pendant que lui-même renverrait la foule.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ሕዝቡን ሲያሰናብት ሳለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በታንኳ ገብተው ወደ ማዶ ወደ ቤተ ሳይዳ እንዲቀድሙት ግድ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
verses.fr: Quand il l''eut renvoyée, il s''en alla sur la montagne, pour prier.
verses.am: ካሰናበታቸውም በኋላ ሊጸልይ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
verses.fr: Le soir étant venu, la barque était au milieu de la mer, et Jésus était seul à terre.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ታንኳይቱ በባሕር መካከል ሳለች እርሱ ብቻውን በምድር ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
verses.fr: Il vit qu''ils avaient beaucoup de peine à ramer; car le vent leur était contraire. A la quatrième veille de la nuit environ, il alla vers eux, marchant sur la mer, et il voulait les dépasser.
verses.am: ነፋስ ወደ ፊታቸው ነበረና እየቀዘፉ ሲጨነቁ አይቶ፥ ከሌሊቱ በአራተኛው ክፍል በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ እነርሱ መጣ፤ ሊያልፋቸውም ይወድ ነበር።

verses.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
verses.fr: Quand ils le virent marcher sur la mer, ils crurent que c''était un fantôme, et ils poussèrent des cris;
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን በባሕር ላይ ሲሄድ ባዩት ጊዜ ምትሀት መሰላቸውና ጮኹ፥

verses.en: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
verses.fr: car ils le voyaient tous, et ils étaient troublés. Aussitôt Jésus leur parla, et leur dit: Rassurez-vous, c''est moi, n''ayez pas peur!
verses.am: ሁሉ አይተውታልና፥ ታወኩም። ወዲያውም ተናገራቸውና። አይዞአችሁ፤ እኔ ነኝ፥ አትፍሩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
verses.fr: Puis il monta vers eux dans la barque, et le vent cessa. Ils furent en eux-mêmes tout stupéfaits et remplis d''étonnement;
verses.am: ወደ እነርሱም ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገባ፥ ነፋሱም ተወ፤ በራሳቸውም ያለ መጠን እጅግ ተገረሙ፤

verses.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
verses.fr: car ils n''avaient pas compris le miracle des pains, parce que leur coeur était endurci.
verses.am: ስለ እንጀራው አላስተዋሉምና፤ ነገር ግን ልባቸው ደንዝዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
verses.fr: Après avoir traversé la mer, ils vinrent dans le pays de Génésareth, et ils abordèrent.
verses.am: ተሻግረውም ወደ ምድር ወደ ጌንሴሬጥ ደረሱ ታንኳይቱንም አስጠጉ።

verses.en: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
verses.fr: Quand ils furent sortis de la barque, les gens, ayant aussitôt reconnu Jésus,
verses.am: ከታንኳይቱም ሲወጡ ወዲያው አውቀውት

verses.en: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
verses.fr: parcoururent tous les environs, et l''on se mit à apporter les malades sur des lits, partout où l''on apprenait qu''il était.
verses.am: በዚያች አገር ሁሉ ዙሪያ ሮጡና እርሱ እንዳለ ወደ ሰሙበት ስፍራ ሕመምተኞችን በአልጋ ላይ ያመጡ ጀመር።

verses.en: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
