verses.fr: En quelque lieu qu''il arrivât, dans les villages, dans les villes ou dans les campagnes, on mettait les malades sur les places publiques, et on le priait de leur permettre seulement de toucher le bord de son vêtement. Et tous ceux qui le touchaient étaient guéris.
verses.am: በገባበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ መንደርም ከተማም ገጠርም ቢሆን፥ በገበያ ድውዮችን ያኖሩ ነበር፤ የልብሱንም ጫፍ እንኳ ሊዳስሱ ይለምኑት ነበር የዳሰሱትም ሁሉ ዳኑ።

verses.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens et quelques scribes, venus de Jérusalem, s''assemblèrent auprès de Jésus.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንና ከጻፎች ወገን ከኢየሩሳሌም የመጡትም ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
verses.fr: Ils virent quelques-uns de ses disciples prendre leurs repas avec des mains impures, c''est-à-dire, non lavées.
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም አንዳንድ በርኵስ ማለት ባልታጠበ እጅ እንጀራ ሲበሉ አዩ።

verses.en: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
verses.fr: Or, les pharisiens et tous les Juifs ne mangent pas sans s''être lavé soigneusement les mains, conformément à la tradition des anciens;
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንና አይሁድም ሁሉ የሽማግሎችን ወግ ሲጠብቁ እጃቸውን ደኅና አድርገው ሳይታጠቡ አይበሉምና፥

verses.en: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
verses.fr: et, quand ils reviennent de la place publique, ils ne mangent qu''après s''être purifiés. Ils ont encore beaucoup d''autres observances traditionnelles, comme le lavage des coupes, des cruches et des vases d''airain.
verses.am: ከገበያም ተመልሰው ካልታጠቡ አይበሉም፥ ጽዋንም ማድጋንም የናስ ዕቃንም አልጋንም እንደ ማጠብ ሌላ ነገር ሊጠብቁት የተቀበሉት ብዙ አለ።

verses.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
verses.fr: Et les pharisiens et les scribes lui demandèrent: Pourquoi tes disciples ne suivent-ils pas la tradition des anciens, mais prennent-ils leurs repas avec des mains impures?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ጻፎችም። ደቀ መዛሙርትህ እንደ ሽማግሌዎች ወግ ስለ ምን አይሄዱም? ነገር ግን እጃቸውን ሳይታጠቡ እንጀራ ይበላሉ ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Hypocrites, Esaïe a bien prophétisé sur vous, ainsi qu''il est écrit: Ce peuple m''honore des lèvres, Mais son coeur est éloigné de moi.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ኢሳይያስ ስለ እናንተ ስለ ግብዞች። ይህ ሕዝብ በከንፈሩ ያከብረኛል ልቡ ግን ከእኔ በጣም የራቀ ነው፤

verses.en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.fr: C''est en vain qu''ils m''honorent, En donnant des préceptes qui sont des commandements d''hommes.
verses.am: የሰውም ሥርዓት የሆነ ትምህርት እያስተማሩ በከንቱ ያመልኩኛል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በእውነት ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.en: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
verses.fr: Vous abandonnez le commandement de Dieu, et vous observez la tradition des hommes.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ትታችሁ ጽዋን ማድጋንም እንደ ማጠብ የሰውን ወግ ትጠብቃላችሁ፥ ይህንም የመሰለ ብዙ ሌላ ነገር ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
verses.fr: Il leur dit encore: Vous anéantissez fort bien le commandement de Dieu, pour garder votre tradition.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ወጋችሁን ትጠብቁ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ እጅግ ንቃችኋል።

verses.en: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
verses.fr: Car Moïse a dit: Honore ton père et ta mère; et: Celui qui maudira son père ou sa mère sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ሙሴ። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ ደግሞ። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሰደበ ፈጽሞ ይሙት ብሎአልና።

verses.en: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
verses.fr: Mais vous, vous dites: Si un homme dit à son père ou à sa mère: Ce dont j''aurais pu t''assister est corban, c''est-à-dire, une offrande à Dieu,
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ትላላችሁ። ሰው አባቱን ወይም እናቱን። ከእኔ የምትጠቀምበት ነገር ሁሉ ቍርባን ማለት መባ ነው ቢል፥

verses.en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
verses.fr: vous ne le laissez plus rien faire pour son père ou pour sa mère,
verses.am: ለአባቱና ለእናቱ ምንም እንኳ ሊያደርግ ወደ ፊት አትፈቅዱለትም፤

verses.en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
verses.fr: annulant ainsi la parole de Dieu par votre tradition, que vous avez établie. Et vous faites beaucoup d''autres choses semblables.
verses.am: ባስተላለፋችሁትም ወግ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ትሽራላችሁ፤ እንደዚሁም ይህን የሚመስል ብዙ ነገር ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
verses.fr: Ensuite, ayant de nouveau appelé la foule à lui, il lui dit: Ecoutez-moi tous, et comprenez.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሕዝቡን ጠርቶ። ሁላችሁ እኔን ስሙ አስተውሉም።

verses.en: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
verses.fr: Il n''est hors de l''homme rien qui, entrant en lui, puisse le souiller; mais ce qui sort de l''homme, c''est ce qui le souille.
verses.am: ከሰው የሚወጡት ሰውን የሚያረክሱ ናቸው እንጂ ከሰው ውጭ የሚገባውስ ሊያረክሰው የሚችል ምንም የለም።

verses.en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un a des oreilles pour entendre, qu''il entende.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ቢኖር ይስማ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut entré dans la maison, loin de la foule, ses disciples l''interrogèrent sur cette parabole.
verses.am: ከሕዝቡ ዘንድ ወደ ቤት ከገባ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ምሳሌውን ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Vous aussi, êtes-vous donc sans intelligence? Ne comprenez-vous pas que rien de ce qui du dehors entre dans l''homme ne peut le souiller?
verses.am: እርሱም። እናንተ ደግሞ እንደዚህ የማታስተውሉ ናችሁን? ከውጭ ወደ ሰው የሚገባ ሊያረክሰው ምንም እንዳይችል አትመለከቱምን?

verses.en: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
verses.fr: Car cela n''entre pas dans son coeur, mais dans son ventre, puis s''en va dans les lieux secrets, qui purifient tous les aliments.
verses.am: ወደ ሆድ ገብቶ ወደ እዳሪ ይወጣል እንጂ ወደ ልብ አይገባምና፤ መብልን ሁሉ እያጠራ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
verses.fr: Il dit encore: Ce qui sort de l''homme, c''est ce qui souille l''homme.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። ከሰው የሚወጣው ሰውን የሚያረክስ ያ ነው።

verses.en: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
verses.fr: Car c''est du dedans, c''est du coeur des hommes, que sortent les mauvaises pensées, les adultères, les impudicités, les meurtres,
verses.am: ከውስጥ ከሰው ልብ የሚወጣ ክፉ አሳብ፥

verses.en: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
verses.fr: les vols, les cupidités, les méchancetés, la fraude, le dérèglement, le regard envieux, la calomnie, l''orgueil, la folie.
verses.am: ዝሙት፥ መስረቅ፥ መግደል፥ ምንዝርነት፥ መጐምጀት፥ ክፋት፥ ተንኰል፥ መዳራት፥ ምቀኝነት፥ ስድብ፥ ትዕቢት፥ ስንፍና ናቸውና፤

verses.en: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
verses.fr: Toutes ces choses mauvaises sortent du dedans, et souillent l''homme.
verses.am: ይህ ክፉው ሁሉ ከውስጥ ይወጣል ሰውን ያረክሰዋል።

verses.en: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
verses.fr: Jésus, étant parti de là, s''en alla dans le territoire de Tyr et de Sidon. Il entra dans une maison, désirant que personne ne le sût; mais il ne put rester caché.
verses.am: ከዚያም ተነሥቶ ወደ ጢሮስና ወደ ሲዶና አገር ሄደ። ወደ ቤትም ገብቶ ማንም እንዳያውቅበት ወደደ ሊሰወርም አልተቻለውም፤

verses.en: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
verses.fr: Car une femme, dont la fille était possédée d''un esprit impur, entendit parler de lui, et vint se jeter à ses pieds.
verses.am: ወዲያው ግን ታናሺቱ ልጅዋ ርኵስ መንፈስ ያደረባት አንዲት ሴት ስለ እርሱ ሰምታ መጣችና በእግሩ ላይ ተደፋች

verses.en: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
verses.fr: Cette femme était grecque, syro-phénicienne d''origine. Elle le pria de chasser le démon hors de sa fille.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ግሪክ፥ ትውልድዋም ሲሮፊኒቃዊት ነበረች፤ ከልጅዋ ጋኔን ያወጣላት ዘንድ ለመነችው።

verses.en: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Laisse d''abord les enfants se rassasier; car il n''est pas bien de prendre le pain des enfants, et de le jeter aux petits chiens.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ልጆቹ በፊት ይጠግቡ ዘንድ ተዪ የልጆቹን እንጀራ ይዞ ለቡችሎች መጣል አይገባምናአላት።

verses.en: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
verses.fr: Oui, Seigneur, lui répondit-elle, mais les petits chiens, sous la table, mangent les miettes des enfants.
verses.am: እርስዋም መልሳ። አዎን፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ቡችሎች እንኳ ከማዕድ በታች ሆነው የልጆችን ፍርፋሪ ይበላሉ አለችው።

verses.en: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
verses.fr: Alors il lui dit: à cause de cette parole, va, le démon est sorti de ta fille.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስለዚህ ቃልሽ ሂጂ ጋኔኑ ከልጅሽ ወጥቶአል አላት።

verses.en: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
verses.fr: Et, quand elle rentra dans sa maison, elle trouva l''enfant couchée sur le lit, le démon étant sorti.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትዋም ሄዳ ጋኔኑ ወጥቶ ልጅዋም በአልጋ ላይ ተኝታ አገኘች።

verses.en: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
verses.fr: Jésus quitta le territoire de Tyr, et revint par Sidon vers la mer de Galilée, en traversant le pays de la Décapole.
verses.am: ደግሞም ከጢሮስ አገር ወጥቶ በሲዶና አልፎ አሥር ከተማ በሚባል አገር መካከል ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር መጣ።

verses.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
verses.fr: On lui amena un sourd, qui avait de la difficulté à parler, et on le pria de lui imposer les mains.
verses.am: ደንቆሮና ኰልታፋም የሆነ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፥

verses.en: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
verses.fr: Il le prit à part loin de la foule, lui mit les doigts dans les oreilles, et lui toucha la langue avec sa propre salive;
verses.am: እጁንም ይጭንበት ዘንድ ለመኑት። ከሕዝቡም ለይቶ ለብቻው ወሰደው፥ ጣቶቹንም በጆሮቹ አገባ እንትፍም ብሎ መላሱን ዳሰሰ፤

verses.en: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
verses.fr: puis, levant les yeux au ciel, il soupira, et dit: Ephphatha, c''est-à-dire, ouvre-toi.
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይም አሻቅቦ አይቶ ቃተተና። ኤፍታህ አለው፥ እርሱም ተከፈት ማለት ነው።

verses.en: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
verses.fr: Aussitôt ses oreilles s''ouvrirent, sa langue se délia, et il parla très bien.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ጆሮቹ ተከፈቱ የመላሱም እስራት ተፈታ አጥርቶም ተናገረ።

verses.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
verses.fr: Jésus leur recommanda de n''en parler à personne; mais plus il le leur recommanda, plus ils le publièrent.
verses.am: ለማንም አትንገሩ ብሎ አዘዛቸው እነርሱ ግን ባዘዛቸውም መጠን ይልቅ እጅግ አወሩት።

verses.en: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
verses.fr: Ils étaient dans le plus grand étonnement, et disaient: Il fait tout à merveille; même il fait entendre les sourds, et parler les muets.
verses.am: ያለ መጠንም ተገረሙና። ሁሉን ደኅና አድርጎአል፤ ደንቆሮችም እንዲሰሙ ዲዳዎችም እንዲናገሩ ያደርጋል አሉ።

verses.en: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
verses.fr: En ces jours-là, une foule nombreuse s''étant de nouveau réunie et n''ayant pas de quoi manger, Jésus appela les disciples, et leur dit:
verses.am: በዚያ ወራት ደግሞ ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበረ የሚበሉትም ስለሌላቸው ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠርቶ።

verses.en: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
verses.fr: Je suis ému de compassion pour cette foule; car voilà trois jours qu''ils sont près de moi, et ils n''ont rien à manger.
verses.am: ሕዝቡ ከእኔ ጋር እስካሁን ሦስት ቀን ውለዋልና የሚበሉት ስለሌላቸው አዝንላቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
verses.fr: Si je les renvoie chez eux à jeun, les forces leur manqueront en chemin; car quelques-uns d''entre eux sont venus de loin.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ከሩቅ መጥተዋልና ጦማቸውን ወደ ቤታቸው ባሰናብታቸው በመንገድ ይዝላሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
verses.fr: Ses disciples lui répondirent: Comment pourrait-on les rassasier de pains, ici, dans un lieu désert?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። በዚህ በምድረ በዳ እንጀራ ከየት አግኝቶ ሰው እነዚህን ማጥገብ ይችላል? ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.en: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
verses.fr: Jésus leur demanda: Combien avez-vous de pains? Sept, répondirent-ils.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስንት እንጀራ አላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው፥ እነርሱም። ሰባት አሉት።

verses.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
verses.fr: Alors il fit asseoir la foule par terre, prit les sept pains, et, après avoir rendu grâces, il les rompit, et les donna à ses disciples pour les distribuer; et ils les distribuèrent à la foule.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በምድር እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ። ሰባቱንም እንጀራ ይዞ አመሰገነ፥ ቈርሶም እንዲያቀርቡላቸው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ለሕዝቡም አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
verses.fr: Ils avaient encore quelques petits poissons, et Jésus, ayant rendu grâces, les fit aussi distribuer.
verses.am: ጥቂትም ትንሽ ዓሣ ነበራቸው፤ ባረከውም ይህንም ደግሞ እንዲያቀርቡላቸው አዘዘ።

verses.en: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
verses.fr: Ils mangèrent et furent rassasiés, et l''on emporta sept corbeilles pleines des morceaux qui restaient.
verses.am: በሉም ጠገቡም፥ የተረፈውንም ቍርስራሽ ሰባት ቅርጫት አነሡ።

verses.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
verses.fr: Ils étaient environ quatre mille. Ensuite Jésus les renvoya.
verses.am: የበሉትም አራት ሺህ ያህል ነበሩ።

verses.en: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.fr: Aussitôt il monta dans la barque avec ses disciples, et se rendit dans la contrée de Dalmanutha.
verses.am: አሰናበታቸውም። ወዲያውም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገብቶ ወደ ዳልማኑታ አገር መጣ።

verses.en: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens survinrent, se mirent à discuter avec Jésus, et, pour l''éprouver, lui demandèrent un signe venant du ciel.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ወጡና ሊፈትኑት ከሰማይ ምልክት ከእርሱ ፈልገው ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከሩ ጀመር።

verses.en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
verses.fr: Jésus, soupirant profondément en son esprit, dit: Pourquoi cette génération demande-t-elle un signe? Je vous le dis en vérité, il ne sera point donné de signe à cette génération.
verses.am: በመንፈሱም እጅግ ቃተተና። ይህ ትውልድ ስለ ምን ምልክት ይፈልጋል? እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ለዚህ ትውልድ ምልክት አይሰጠውም አለ።

verses.en: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
verses.fr: Puis il les quitta, et remonta dans la barque, pour passer sur l''autre bord.
verses.am: ትቶአቸውም እንደ ገና ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገብቶ ወደ ማዶ ሄደ።

verses.en: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
verses.fr: Les disciples avaient oublié de prendre des pains; ils n''en avaient qu''un seul avec eux dans la barque.
verses.am: እንጀራ መያዝም ረሱ፥ ለእነርሱም ከአንድ እንጀራ በቀር በታንኳይቱ አልነበራቸውም።

verses.en: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
verses.fr: Jésus leur fit cette recommandation: Gardez-vous avec soin du levain des pharisiens et du levain d''Hérode.
verses.am: እርሱም። ተጠንቀቁ፤ ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሄሮድስ እርሾ ተጠበቁ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
verses.fr: Les disciples raisonnaient entre eux, et disaient: C''est parce que nous n''avons pas de pains.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። እንጀራ ስለሌለን ይሆናል ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
verses.fr: Jésus, l''ayant connu, leur dit: Pourquoi raisonnez-vous sur ce que vous n''avez pas de pains? Etes-vous encore sans intelligence, et ne comprenez-vous pas? Avez-vous le coeur endurci?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እንጀራ ስለሌላችሁ ስለ ምን ትነጋገራላችሁ? ገና አልተመለከታችሁምን? አላስተዋላችሁምን?

verses.en: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
verses.fr: Ayant des yeux, ne voyez-vous pas? Ayant des oreilles, n''entendez-vous pas? Et n''avez-vous point de mémoire?
verses.am: ልባችሁስ ደንዝዞአልን? ዓይን ሳላችሁ አታዩምን? ጆሮስ ሳላችሁ አትሰሙምን? ትዝስ አይላችሁምን?

verses.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
verses.fr: Quand j''ai rompu les cinq pains pour les cinq mille hommes, combien de paniers pleins de morceaux avez-vous emportés? Douze, lui répondirent-ils.
verses.am: አምስቱን እንጀራ ለአምስት ሺህ በቈረስሁ ጊዜ፥ ቍርስራሹ የሞላ ስንት መሶብ አነሣችሁ? እነርሱም። አሥራ ሁለት አሉት።

verses.en: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
verses.fr: Et quand j''ai rompu les sept pains pour les quatre mille hommes, combien de corbeilles pleines de morceaux avez-vous emportées? Sept, répondirent-ils.
verses.am: ሰባቱን እንጀራስ ለአራት ሺህ በቈረስሁ ጊዜ፥ ቍርስራሹ የሞላ ስንት ቅርጫት አነሣችሁ? እነርሱም። ሰባት አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Ne comprenez-vous pas encore?
verses.am: ገና አላስተዋላችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
verses.fr: Ils se rendirent à Bethsaïda; et on amena vers Jésus un aveugle, qu''on le pria de toucher.
verses.am: ወደ ቤተ ሳይዳም መጡ። ዕውርም አመጡለት፥ እንዲዳስሰውም ለመኑት።

verses.en: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
verses.fr: Il prit l''aveugle par la main, et le conduisit hors du village; puis il lui mit de la salive sur les yeux, lui imposa les mains, et lui demanda s''il voyait quelque chose.
verses.am: ዕውሩንም እጁን ይዞ ከመንደር ውጭ አወጣው፥ በዓይኑም ተፍቶበት እጁንም ጭኖበት። አንዳች ታያለህን ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
verses.fr: Il regarda, et dit: J''aperçois les hommes, mais j''en vois comme des arbres, et qui marchent.
verses.am: አሻቅቦም። ሰዎች እንደ ዛፍ ሲመላለሱ አያለሁ አለ።

verses.en: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
verses.fr: Jésus lui mit de nouveau les mains sur les yeux; et, quand l''aveugle regarda fixement, il fut guéri, et vit tout distinctement.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ደግሞ እጁን በዓይኑ ላይ ጫነበት አጥርቶም አየና ዳነም ከሩቅም ሳይቀር ሁሉን ተመለከተ።

verses.en: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus le renvoya dans sa maison, en disant: N''entre pas au village.
verses.am: ወደ ቤቱም ሰደደውና። ወደ መንደሩ አትግባ በመንደሩም ለማንም አንዳች አትናገር አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
verses.fr: Jésus s''en alla, avec ses disciples, dans les villages de Césarée de Philippe, et il leur posa en chemin cette question: Qui dit-on que je suis?
verses.am: ኢየሱስና ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በፊልጶስ ቂሣርያ ወዳሉ መንደሮች ወጡ በመንገድም። ሰዎች እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ይላሉ? ብሎ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠየቃቸው።

verses.en: And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Jean Baptiste; les autres, Elie, les autres, l''un des prophètes.
verses.am: እነርሱም። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤልያስ፥ ሌሎችም ከነቢያት አንዱ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
verses.fr: Et vous, leur demanda-t-il, qui dites-vous que je suis? Pierre lui répondit: Tu es le Christ.
verses.am: እናንተስ እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። ጴጥሮስም። አንተ ክርስቶስ ነህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
verses.fr: Jésus leur recommanda sévèrement de ne dire cela de lui à personne.
verses.am: ስለ እርሱም ለማንም እንዳይናገሩ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.fr: Alors il commença à leur apprendre qu''il fallait que le Fils de l''homme souffrît beaucoup, qu''il fût rejeté par les anciens, par les principaux sacrificateurs et par les scribes, qu''il fût mis à mort, et qu''il ressuscitât trois jours après.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ብዙ መከራ ሊቀበል፥ ከሽማግሌዎችም ከካህናት አለቆችም ከጻፎችም ሊጣል፥ ሊገደልም ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ ሊነሣ እንዲገባው ያስተምራቸው ጀመር፤ ቃሉንም ገልጦ ይናገር ነበር።

verses.en: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.fr: Il leur disait ces choses ouvertement. Et Pierre, l''ayant pris à part, se mit à le reprendre.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ እርሱ ወስዶ ይገሥጸው ጀመር።

verses.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, se retournant et regardant ses disciples, réprimanda Pierre, et dit: Arrière de moi, Satan! car tu ne conçois pas les choses de Dieu, tu n''as que des pensées humaines.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ዘወር አለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም አይቶ ጴጥሮስን ገሠጸውና። ወደ ኋላዬ ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን፤ የሰውን እንጂ የእግዚአብሔርን ነገር አታስብምና አለው።

verses.en: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.fr: Puis, ayant appelé la foule avec ses disciples, il leur dit: Si quelqu''un veut venir après moi, qu''il renonce à lui-même, qu''il se charge de sa croix, et qu''il me suive.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። በኋላዬ ሊመጣ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

verses.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
verses.fr: Car celui qui voudra sauver sa vie la perdra, mais celui qui perdra sa vie à cause de moi et de la bonne nouvelle la sauvera.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታልና፥ ስለ እኔና ስለ ወንጌል ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ግን ያድናታል።

verses.en: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
verses.fr: Et que sert-il à un homme de gagner tout le monde, s''il perd son âme?
verses.am: ሰው ዓለምን ሁሉ ቢያተርፍ ነፍሱንም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል?

verses.en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.fr: Que donnerait un homme en échange de son âme?
verses.am: ሰውስ ስለ ነፍሱ ቤዛ ምን ይሰጣል?

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
verses.fr: Car quiconque aura honte de moi et de mes paroles au milieu de cette génération adultère et pécheresse, le Fils de l''homme aura aussi honte de lui, quand il viendra dans la gloire de son Père, avec les saints anges.
verses.am: በዚህም በዘማዊና በኃጢአተኛ ትውልድ መካከል በእኔና በቃሌ የሚያፍር ሁሉ፥ የሰው ልጅ ደግሞ በአባቱ ክብር ከቅዱሳን መላእክት ጋር በመጣ ጊዜ በእርሱ ያፍርበታል።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
verses.fr: Il leur dit encore: Je vous le dis en vérité, quelques-uns de ceux qui sont ici ne mourront point, qu''ils n''aient vu le royaume de Dieu venir avec puissance.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚህ ከቆሙት ሰዎች የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በኃይል ስትመጣ እስኪያዩ ድረስ፥ ሞትን የማይቀምሱ አንዳንዶች አሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
verses.fr: Six jours après, Jésus prit avec lui Pierre, Jacques et Jean, et il les conduisit seuls à l''écart sur une haute montagne. Il fut transfiguré devant eux;
verses.am: ከስድስት ቀንም በኋላ ኢየሱስ ጴጥሮስንና ያዕቆብን ዮሐንስንም ይዞ ወደ ረጅም ተራራ ብቻቸውን አወጣቸው። በፊታቸውም ተለወጠ፥ ልብሱም አንጸባረቀ፤

verses.en: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
verses.fr: ses vêtements devinrent resplendissants, et d''une telle blancheur qu''il n''est pas de foulon sur la terre qui puisse blanchir ainsi.
verses.am: አጣቢም በምድር ላይ እንደዚያ ሊያነጣው እስከማይችል በጣም ነጭ ሆነ።

verses.en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.fr: Elie et Moïse leur apparurent, s''entretenant avec Jésus.
verses.am: ኤልያስና ሙሴም ታዩአቸው፥ ከኢየሱስም ጋር ይነጋገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.fr: Pierre, prenant la parole, dit à Jésus: Rabbi, il est bon que nous soyons ici; dressons trois tentes, une pour toi, une pour Moïse, et une pour Elie.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ ኢየሱስን። መምህር ሆይ፥ በዚህ መሆን ለእኛ መልካም ነውና አንድ ለአንተ አንድም ለሙሴ አንድም ለኤልያስ ሦስት ዳሶች እንሥራ አለው።

verses.en: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
verses.fr: Car il ne savait que dire, l''effroi les ayant saisis.
verses.am: እጅግ ስለ ፈሩ የሚለውን አያውቅም ነበር።

verses.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.fr: Une nuée vint les couvrir, et de la nuée sortit une voix: Celui-ci est mon Fils bien-aimé: écoutez-le!
verses.am: ደመናም መጥቶ ጋረዳቸው፥ ከደመናውም። የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው፥ እርሱን ስሙት የሚል ድምፅ መጣ።

verses.en: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.fr: Aussitôt les disciples regardèrent tout autour, et ils ne virent que Jésus seul avec eux.
verses.am: ድንገትም ዞረው ሲመለከቱ ከእነርሱ ጋር ከኢየሱስ ብቻ በቀር ማንንም አላዩም።

verses.en: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
verses.fr: Comme ils descendaient de la montagne, Jésus leur recommanda de ne dire à personne ce qu''ils avaient vu, jusqu''à ce que le Fils de l''homme fût ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: ከተራራውም ሲወርዱ የሰው ልጅ ከሙታን እስኪነሣ ድረስ ያዩትን ለማንም እንዳይነግሩ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
verses.fr: Ils retinrent cette parole, se demandant entre eux ce que c''est que ressusciter des morts.
verses.am: ቃሉንም ይዘው። ከሙታን መነሣት ምንድር ነው? እያሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ተጠያየቁ።

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.fr: Les disciples lui firent cette question: Pourquoi les scribes disent-ils qu''il faut qu''Elie vienne premièrement?
verses.am: እነርሱም። ኤልያስ አስቀድሞ ሊመጣ እንዲገባው ጻፎች ስለ ምን ይላሉ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Elie viendra premièrement, et rétablira toutes choses. Et pourquoi est-il écrit du Fils de l''homme qu''il doit souffrir beaucoup et être méprisé?
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ኤልያስማ አስቀድሞ ይመጣል ሁሉንም ያቀናናል፤ ስለ ሰው ልጅም እንዴት ተብሎ ተጽፎአል? ብዙ መከራ እንዲቀበል እንዲናቅም።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
verses.fr: Mais je vous dis qu''Elie est venu, et qu''ils l''ont traité comme ils ont voulu, selon qu''il est écrit de lui.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ኤልያስ ደግሞ መጥቶአል፥ ስለ እርሱም እንደ ተጸፈ የወደዱትን ሁሉ አደረጉበት አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent arrivés près des disciples, ils virent autour d''eux une grande foule, et des scribes qui discutaient avec eux.
verses.am: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በመጣ ጊዜ ብዙ ሕዝብ ሲከብቡአቸው ጻፎችም ከእነርሱ ጋር ሲከራከሩ አየ።

verses.en: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
verses.fr: Dès que la foule vit Jésus, elle fut surprise, et accourut pour le saluer.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ባዩት ጊዜ ደነገጡ፥ ወደ እርሱም ሮጠው እጅ ነሡት።

verses.en: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
verses.fr: Il leur demanda: Sur quoi discutez-vous avec eux?
verses.am: ጻፎችንም። ስለ ምን ከእነርሱ ጋር ትከራከራላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.en: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
verses.fr: Et un homme de la foule lui répondit: Maître, j''ai amené auprès de toi mon fils, qui est possédé d''un esprit muet.
verses.am: ከሕዝቡ አንዱ መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ዲዳ መንፈስ ያደረበትን ልጄን ወደ አንተ አምጥቼአለሁ፤

verses.en: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
verses.fr: En quelque lieu qu''il le saisisse, il le jette par terre; l''enfant écume, grince des dents, et devient tout raide. J''ai prié tes disciples de chasser l''esprit, et ils n''ont pas pu.
verses.am: በያዘውም ስፍራ ሁሉ ይጥለዋል፤ አረፋም ይደፍቃል፥ ጥርሱንም ያፋጫል ይደርቃልም፤ እንዲያወጡለትም ለደቀ መዛሙርትህ ነገርኋቸው፥ አልቻሉምም አለው።

verses.en: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
verses.fr: Race incrédule, leur dit Jésus, jusques à quand serai-je avec vous? jusques à quand vous supporterai-je? Amenez-le-moi.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። የማታምን ትውልድ ሆይ፥ እስከመቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እኖራለሁ? እስከ መቼስ እታገሣችኋለሁ? ወደ እኔ አምጡት አላቸው።

verses.en: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.fr: On le lui amena. Et aussitôt que l''enfant vit Jésus, l''esprit l''agita avec violence; il tomba par terre, et se roulait en écumant.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም አመጡት። እርሱንም ባየ ጊዜ ያ መንፈስ ወዲያው አንፈራገጠው፤ ወደ ምድርም ወድቆ አረፋ እየደፈቀ ተንፈራፈረ።

verses.en: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
verses.fr: Jésus demanda au père: Combien y a-t-il de temps que cela lui arrive? Depuis son enfance, répondit-il.
verses.am: አባቱንም። ይህ ከያዘው ስንት ዘመን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም። ከሕፃንነቱ ጀምሮ ነው፤

verses.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.fr: Et souvent l''esprit l''a jeté dans le feu et dans l''eau pour le faire périr. Mais, si tu peux quelque chose, viens à notre secours, aie compassion de nous.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜም ሊያጠፋው ወደ እሳትም ወደ ውኃም ጣለው፤ ቢቻልህ ግን እዘንልን እርዳንም አለው።

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Si tu peux!... Tout est possible à celui qui croit.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ቢቻልህ ትላለህ፤ ለሚያምን ሁሉ ይቻላል አለው።

verses.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.fr: Aussitôt le père de l''enfant s''écria: Je crois! viens au secours de mon incrédulité!
verses.am: ወዲያውም የብላቴናው አባት ጮኾ። አምናለሁ፤ አለማመኔን እርዳው አለ።

verses.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant accourir la foule, menaça l''esprit impur, et lui dit: Esprit muet et sourd, je te l''ordonne, sors de cet enfant, et n''y rentre plus.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሕዝቡ እንደ ገና ሲራወጥ አይቶ ርኵሱን መንፈስ ገሠጸና። አንተ ዲዳ ደንቆሮም መንፈስ፥ እኔ አዝሃለሁ፥ ከእርሱ ውጣ እንግዲህም አትግባበት አለው።

verses.en: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
verses.fr: Et il sortit, en poussant des cris, et en l''agitant avec une grande violence. L''enfant devint comme mort, de sorte que plusieurs disaient qu''il était mort.
verses.am: ጮኾም እጅግም አንፈራግጦት ወጣ፤ ብዙዎችም። ሞተ እስኪሉ ድረስ እንደ ሙት ሆነ።

verses.en: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, l''ayant pris par la main, le fit lever. Et il se tint debout.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን እጁን ይዞ አስነሣው ቆመም።

verses.en: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.fr: Quand Jésus fut entré dans la maison, ses disciples lui demandèrent en particulier: Pourquoi n''avons-nous pu chasser cet esprit?
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም ከገባ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። እኛ ልናወጣው ያልቻልን ስለ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ብቻውን ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Cette espèce-là ne peut sortir que par la prière.
verses.am: ይህ ወገን በጸሎትና በጦም ካልሆነ በምንም ሊወጣ አይችልም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de là, et traversèrent la Galilée. Jésus ne voulait pas qu''on le sût.
verses.am: እነርሱም ነገሩን አላስተዋሉም፥ እንዳይጠይቁትም ፈሩ።

verses.en: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
verses.fr: Car il enseignait ses disciples, et il leur dit: Le Fils de l''homme sera livré entre les mains des hommes; ils le feront mourir, et, trois jours après qu''il aura été mis à mort, il ressuscitera.
verses.am: እነርሱም ነገሩን አላስተዋሉም፥ እንዳይጠይቁትም ፈሩ።

verses.en: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.fr: Mais les disciples ne comprenaient pas cette parole, et ils craignaient de l''interroger.
verses.am: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም መጣ። በቤትም ሆኖ። በመንገድ እርስ በርሳችሁ ምን ተነጋገራችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.en: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à Capernaüm. Lorsqu''il fut dans la maison, Jésus leur demanda: De quoi discutiez-vous en chemin?
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን በመንገድ። ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ ማን ይሆን? ተባብለው ነበርና ዝም አሉ።

verses.en: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
verses.fr: Mais ils gardèrent le silence, car en chemin ils avaient discuté entre eux pour savoir qui était le plus grand.
verses.am: ተቀምጦም አሥራ ሁለቱን ጠርቶ። ሰው ፊተኛ ሊሆን ቢወድ ከሁሉ በኋላ የሁሉም አገልጋይ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.en: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.fr: Alors il s''assit, appela les douze, et leur dit: Si quelqu''un veut être le premier, il sera le dernier de tous et le serviteur de tous.
verses.am: ሕፃንም ይዞ በመካከላቸው አቆመው አቅፎም።

verses.en: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.fr: Et il prit un petit enfant, le plaça au milieu d''eux, et l''ayant pris dans ses bras, il leur dit:
verses.am: እንደዚህ ካሉ ሕፃናት አንዱን በስሜ የሚቀበል ሁሉ እኔን ይቀበላል፤ የሚቀበለኝም ሁሉ የላከኝን እንጂ እኔን አይቀበልም አላቸው።

verses.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.fr: Quiconque reçoit en mon nom un de ces petits enfants me reçoit moi-même; et quiconque me reçoit, reçoit non pas moi, mais celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አንድ ሰው በስምህ አጋንንትን ሲያወጣ አየነው፥

verses.en: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
verses.fr: Jean lui dit: Maître, nous avons vu un homme qui chasse des démons en ton nom; et nous l''en avons empêché, parce qu''il ne nous suit pas.
verses.am: ስለማይከተለንም ከለከልነው አለው። ኢየሱስ ግን አለ። በስሜ ተአምር ሠርቶ በቶሎ በእኔ ላይ ክፉ መናገር የሚችል ማንም የለምና አትከልክሉት፤

verses.en: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
verses.fr: Ne l''en empêchez pas, répondit Jésus, car il n''est personne qui, faisant un miracle en mon nom, puisse aussitôt après parler mal de moi.
verses.am: የማይቃወመን እርሱ ከእኛ ጋር ነውና።

verses.en: For he that is not against us is on our part.
verses.fr: Qui n''est pas contre nous est pour nous.
verses.am: የክርስቶስ ስለ ሆናችሁ በስሜ ጽዋ ውኃ የሚያጠጣችሁ ሁሉ፥ ዋጋው እንዳይጠፋበት እውነት እላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
verses.fr: Et quiconque vous donnera à boire un verre d''eau en mon nom, parce que vous appartenez à Christ, je vous le dis en vérité, il ne perdra point sa récompense.
verses.am: በእኔም ከሚያምኑት ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን የሚያሰናክል ሁሉ ትልቅ የወፍጮ ድንጋይ በአንገቱ ታስሮ ወደ ባሕር ቢጣል ይሻለው ነበር።

verses.en: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
verses.fr: Mais, si quelqu''un scandalisait un de ces petits qui croient, il vaudrait mieux pour lui qu''on lui mît au cou une grosse meule de moulin, et qu''on le jetât dans la mer.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቀመማልና፥ መሥዋዕትም ሁሉ በጨው ይቀመማል።

verses.en: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.fr: Si ta main est pour toi une occasion de chute, coupe-la; mieux vaut pour toi entrer manchot dans la vie,
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቀመማልና፥ መሥዋዕትም ሁሉ በጨው ይቀመማል።

verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.fr: que d''avoir les deux mains et d''aller dans la géhenne, dans le feu qui ne s''éteint point.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቀመማልና፥ መሥዋዕትም ሁሉ በጨው ይቀመማል።

verses.en: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.fr: Si ton pied est pour toi une occasion de chute, coupe-le; mieux vaut pour toi entrer boiteux dans la vie,
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቀመማልና፥ መሥዋዕትም ሁሉ በጨው ይቀመማል።

verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.fr: que d''avoir les deux pieds et d''être jeté dans la géhenne, dans le feu qui ne s''éteint point.
verses.am: ጨው መልካም ነው፤ ጨው ግን አልጫ ቢሆን በምን ታጣፍጡታላችሁ? በነፍሳችሁ ጨው ይኑርባችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁም ተስማሙ።

verses.en: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
verses.fr: Et si ton oeil est pour toi une occasion de chute, arrache-le; mieux vaut pour toi entrer dans le royaume de Dieu n''ayant qu''un oeil, que d''avoir deux yeux et d''être jeté dans la géhenne,

verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.fr: où leur ver ne meurt point, et où le feu ne s''éteint point.
verses.am: ዓይንህ ብታሰናክልህ አውጣት፤ ሁለት ዓይን ኖሮህ ትላቸው ወደማይሞትበት እሳቱም ወደማይጠፋበት ወደ ገሃነመ እሳት ከመጣል አንዲት ዓይን ኖራህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት ይሻልሃል።

verses.en: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
verses.fr: Car tout homme sera salé de feu.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቀመማልና፥ መሥዋዕትም ሁሉ በጨው ይቀመማል።

verses.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
verses.fr: Le sel est une bonne chose; mais si le sel devient sans saveur, avec quoi l''assaisonnerez-vous? Ayez du sel en vous-mêmes, et soyez en paix les uns avec les autres.
verses.am: ጨው መልካም ነው፤ ጨው ግን አልጫ ቢሆን በምን ታጣፍጡታላችሁ? በነፍሳችሁ ጨው ይኑርባችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁም ተስማሙ።

verses.en: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.fr: Jésus, étant parti de là, se rendit dans le territoire de la Judée au delà du Jourdain. La foule s''assembla de nouveau près de lui, et selon sa coutume, il se mit encore à l''enseigner.
verses.am: ከዚያም ተነሥቶ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ይሁዳ አገር መጣ፥ ደግሞም ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ እንደ ልማዱም ደግሞ ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens l''abordèrent; et, pour l''éprouver, ils lui demandèrent s''il est permis à un homme de répudier sa femme.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ቀርበው። ሰው ሚስቱን ሊፈታ ተፈቅዶለታልን? ብለው ሊፈትኑት ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Que vous a prescrit Moïse?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። ሙሴ ምን አዘዛችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
verses.fr: Moïse, dirent-ils, a permis d''écrire une lettre de divorce et de répudier.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሙሴስ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ጽፎ እንዲፈታት ፈቀደ አሉ።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.fr: Et Jésus leur dit: C''est à cause de la dureté de votre coeur que Moïse vous a donné ce précepte.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ስለ ልባችሁ ጥንካሬ ይህችን ትእዛዝ ጻፈላችሁ።

verses.en: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
verses.fr: Mais au commencement de la création, Dieu fit l''homme et la femme;
verses.am: ከፍጥረት መጀመሪያ ግን እግዚአብሔር ወንድና ሴት አደረጋቸው፤

verses.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
verses.fr: c''est pourquoi l''homme quittera son père et sa mère, et s''attachera à sa femme,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል፥

verses.en: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
verses.fr: et les deux deviendront une seule chair. Ainsi ils ne sont plus deux, mais ils sont une seule chair.
verses.am: ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ፤ ስለዚህ አንድ ሥጋ ናቸው እንጂ ወደ ፊት ሁለት አይደሉም።

verses.en: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.fr: Que l''homme donc ne sépare pas ce que Dieu a joint.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያጣመረውን እንግዲህ ሰው አይለየው።

verses.en: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent dans la maison, les disciples l''interrogèrent encore là-dessus.
verses.am: በቤትም ደግሞ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለዚህ ነገር ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Celui qui répudie sa femme et qui en épouse une autre, commet un adultère à son égard;
verses.am: እርሱም። ሚስቱን ፈትቶ ሌላ የሚያገባ ሁሉ በእርስዋ ላይ ያመነዝራል፤

verses.en: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
verses.fr: et si une femme quitte son mari et en épouse un autre, elle commet un adultère.
verses.am: እርስዋም ባልዋን ፈትታ ሌላ ብታገባ ታመነዝራለች አላቸው።

verses.en: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
verses.fr: On lui amena des petits enfants, afin qu''il les touchât. Mais les disciples reprirent ceux qui les amenaient.
verses.am: እንዲዳስሳቸውም ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ያመጡአቸውን ገሠጹአቸው።

verses.en: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant cela, fut indigné, et leur dit: Laissez venir à moi les petits enfants, et ne les en empêchez pas; car le royaume de Dieu est pour ceux qui leur ressemblent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን አይቶ ተቈጣና። ሕፃናትን ወደ እኔ ይመጡ ዘንድ ተዉ አትከልክሉአቸው፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደነዚህ ላሉት ናትና።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, quiconque ne recevra pas le royaume de Dieu comme un petit enfant n''y entrera point.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ከቶ አይገባባትም አላቸው።

verses.en: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
verses.fr: Puis il les prit dans ses bras, et les bénit, en leur imposant les mains.
verses.am: አቀፋቸውም እጁንም ጭኖ ባረካቸው።

verses.en: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.fr: Comme Jésus se mettait en chemin, un homme accourut, et se jetant à genoux devant lui: Bon maître, lui demanda-t-il, que dois-je faire pour hériter la vie éternelle?
verses.am: እርሱም በመንገድ ሲወጣ አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ ሮጦ ተንበረከከለትና። ቸር መምህር ሆይ፥ የዘላለም ሕይወትን እወርስ ዘንድ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Pourquoi m''appelles-tu bon? Il n''y a de bon que Dieu seul.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስለ ምን ቸር ትለኛለህ? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ቸር ማንም የለም።

verses.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
verses.fr: Tu connais les commandements: Tu ne commettras point d''adultère; tu ne tueras point; tu ne déroberas point; tu ne diras point de faux témoignage; tu ne feras tort à personne; honore ton père et ta mère.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትን ታውቃለህ፤ አታመንዝር፥ አትግደል፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥ አታታልል፥ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር አለው።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
verses.fr: Il lui répondit: Maître, j''ai observé toutes ces choses dès ma jeunesse.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህን ሁሉ ከሕፃንነቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
verses.fr: Jésus, l''ayant regardé, l''aima, et lui dit: Il te manque une chose; va, vends tout ce que tu as, donne-le aux pauvres, et tu auras un trésor dans le ciel. Puis viens, et suis-moi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ተመልክቶ ወደደውና። አንድ ነገር ጐደለህ፤ ሂድ፥ ያለህን ሁሉ ሽጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ በሰማይም መዝገብ ታገኛለህ፥ መስቀሉንም ተሸክመህ ና፥ ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
verses.fr: Mais, affligé de cette parole, cet homme s''en alla tout triste; car il avait de grands biens.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስለዚህ ነገር ፊቱ ጠቈረ፥ ብዙ ንብረት ነበረውና እያዘነም ሄደ።

verses.en: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.fr: Jésus, regardant autour de lui, dit à ses disciples: Qu''il sera difficile à ceux qui ont des richesses d''entrer dans le royaume de Dieu!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ አይቶ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። ገንዘብ ላላቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ይሆናል አላቸው።

verses.en: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.fr: Les disciples furent étonnés de ce que Jésus parlait ainsi. Et, reprenant, il leur dit: Mes enfants, qu''il est difficile à ceux qui se confient dans les richesses d''entrer dans le royaume de Dieu!
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም እነዚህን ቃሎች አደነቁ። ኢየሱስም ደግሞ መልሶ። ልጆች ሆይ፥ በገንዘብ ለሚታመኑ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Il est plus facile à un chameau de passer par le trou d''une aiguille qu''à un riche d''entrer dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ባለ ጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ቢያልፍ ይቀላል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
verses.fr: Les disciples furent encore plus étonnés, et ils se dirent les uns aux autres; Et qui peut être sauvé?
verses.am: እነርሱም ያለ መጠን ተገረሙና እርስ በርሳቸው። እንግዲያ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.fr: Jésus les regarda, et dit: Cela est impossible aux hommes, mais non à Dieu: car tout est possible à Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ተመለከታቸውና። ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እንጂ በሰው ዘንድ አይቻልም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሁሉ ይቻላልና አለ።

verses.en: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
verses.fr: Pierre se mit à lui dire; Voici, nous avons tout quitté, et nous t''avons suivi.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ ይለው ጀመር።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Je vous le dis en vérité, il n''est personne qui, ayant quitté, à cause de moi et à cause de la bonne nouvelle, sa maison, ou ses frères, ou ses soeurs, ou sa mère, ou son père, ou ses enfants, ou ses terres,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ እኔና ስለ ወንጌል ቤትን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ፥

verses.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
verses.fr: ne reçoive au centuple, présentement dans ce siècle-ci, des maisons, des frères, des soeurs, des mères, des enfants, et des terres, avec des persécutions, et, dans le siècle à venir, la vie éternelle.
verses.am: አሁን በዚህ ዘመን ከስደት ጋር ቤቶችን ወንድሞችንና እኅቶችንም እናቶችንም ልጆችንም እርሻንም መቶ እጥፍ፥ በሚመጣውም ዓለም የዘላለም ሕይወት የማይቀበል ማንም የለም።

verses.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
verses.fr: Plusieurs des premiers seront les derniers, et plusieurs des derniers seront les premiers.
verses.am: ግን ብዙ ፊተኞች ኋለኞች ኋለኞችም ፊተኞች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
verses.fr: Ils étaient en chemin pour monter à Jérusalem, et Jésus allait devant eux. Les disciples étaient troublés, et le suivaient avec crainte. Et Jésus prit de nouveau les douze auprès de lui, et commença à leur dire ce qui devait lui arriver:
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሊወጡ በመንገድ ነበሩ፥ ኢየሱስም ይቀድማቸው ነበርና ተደነቁ፤ የተከተሉትም ይፈሩ ነበር። ደግሞም አሥራ ሁለቱን ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ ይደርስበት ዘንድ ያለውን ይነግራቸው ጀመር።

verses.en: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
verses.fr: Voici, nous montons à Jérusalem, et le Fils de l''homme sera livré aux principaux sacrificateurs et aux scribes. Ils le condamneront à mort, et ils le livreront aux païens,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ የሰው ልጅም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለጻፎች አልፎ ይሰጣል፥ የሞት ፍርድም ይፈርዱበታል፥ ለአሕዛብም አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል፥

verses.en: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.fr: qui se moqueront de lui, cracheront sur lui, le battront de verges, et le feront mourir; et, trois jours après, il ressuscitera.
verses.am: ይዘብቱበትማል ይተፉበትማል ይገርፉትማል ይገድሉትማል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው።

verses.en: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
verses.fr: Les fils de Zébédée, Jacques et Jean, s''approchèrent de Jésus, et lui dirent: Maître, nous voudrions que tu fisses pour nous ce que nous te demanderons.
verses.am: የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። መምህር ሆይ፥ የምንለምንህን ሁሉ እንድታደርግልን እንወዳለን አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Que voulez-vous que je fasse pour vous?
verses.am: እርሱም። ምን ላደርግላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
verses.fr: Accorde-nous, lui dirent-ils, d''être assis l''un à ta droite et l''autre à ta gauche, quand tu seras dans ta gloire.
verses.am: እነርሱም። በክብርህ ጊዜ አንዳችን በቀኝ አንዳችንም በግራህ መቀመጥን ስጠን አሉት።

verses.en: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Vous ne savez ce que vous demandez. Pouvez-vous boire la coupe que je dois boire, ou être baptisés du baptême dont je dois être baptisé?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። የምትለምኑትን አታውቁም። እኔ የምጠጣውን ጽዋ ልትጠጡ፥ እኔ የምጠመቀውንስ ጥምቀት ልትጠመቁ ትችላላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
verses.fr: Nous le pouvons, dirent-ils. Et Jésus leur répondit: Il est vrai que vous boirez la coupe que je dois boire, et que vous serez baptisés du baptême dont je dois être baptisé;
verses.am: እነርሱም። እንችላለን አሉት። ኢየሱስም። እኔ የምጠጣውን ጽዋ ትጠጣላችሁ፥ እኔ የምጠመቀውንም ጥምቀት ትጠመቃላችሁ፤

verses.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
verses.fr: mais pour ce qui est d''être assis à ma droite ou à ma gauche, cela ne dépend pas de moi, et ne sera donné qu''à ceux à qui cela est réservé.
verses.am: በቀኝና በግራ መቀመጥ ግን ለተዘጋጀላቸው ነው እንጂ የምሰጥ እኔ አይደለሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
verses.fr: Les dix, ayant entendu cela, commencèrent à s''indigner contre Jacques et Jean.
verses.am: አሥሩም ሰምተው በያዕቆብና በዮሐንስ ይቈጡ ጀመር።

verses.en: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
verses.fr: Jésus les appela, et leur dit: Vous savez que ceux qu''on regarde comme les chefs des nations les tyrannisent, et que les grands les dominent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የአሕዛብ አለቆች ተብሎ የምታስቡት እንዲገዙአቸው ታላላቆቻቸውም በላያቸው እንዲሠለጥኑ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
verses.fr: Il n''en est pas de même au milieu de vous. Mais quiconque veut être grand parmi vous, qu''il soit votre serviteur;
verses.am: በእናንተስ እንዲህ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ማንም ከእናንተ ታላቅ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ አገልጋይ ይሁን፥

verses.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
verses.fr: et quiconque veut être le premier parmi vous, qu''il soit l''esclave de tous.
verses.am: ከእናንተም ማንም ፊተኛ ሊሆን የሚወድ የሁሉ ባሪያ ይሁን፤

verses.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.fr: Car le Fils de l''homme est venu, non pour être servi, mais pour servir et donner sa vie comme la rançon de plusieurs.
verses.am: እንዲሁ የሰው ልጅም ሊያገለግልና ነፍሱን ለብዙዎች ቤዛ ሊሰጥ እንጂ እንዲያገለግሉት አልመጣም።

verses.en: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à Jéricho. Et, lorsque Jésus en sortit, avec ses disciples et une assez grande foule, le fils de Timée, Bartimée, mendiant aveugle, était assis au bord du chemin.
verses.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም መጡ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቱና ከብዙ ሕዝብ ጋር ከኢያሪኮ ሲወጣ የጤሜዎስ ልጅ ዕውሩ በርጤሜዎስ እየለመነ በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.fr: Il entendit que c''était Jésus de Nazareth, et il se mit à crier; Fils de David, Jésus aie pitié de moi!
verses.am: የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስም እንደ ሆነ በሰማ ጊዜ። የዳዊት ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ ይጮኽ ጀመር።

verses.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.fr: Plusieurs le reprenaient, pour le faire taire; mais il criait beaucoup plus fort; Fils de David, aie pitié de moi!
verses.am: ብዙዎችም ዝም እንዲል ገሠጹት፤ እርሱ ግን። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ አብዝቶ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
verses.fr: Jésus s''arrêta, et dit: Appelez-le. Ils appelèrent l''aveugle, en lui disant: Prends courage, lève-toi, il t''appelle.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቆመና። ጥሩት አለ። ዕውሩንም። አይዞህ፥ ተነሣ፥ ይጠራሃል ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.en: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
verses.fr: L''aveugle jeta son manteau, et, se levant d''un bond, vint vers Jésus.
verses.am: እርሱም እየዘለለ ተነሣና ልብሱን ጥሎ ወደ ኢየሱስ መጣ።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
verses.fr: Jésus, prenant la parole, lui dit: Que veux-tu que je te fasse? Rabbouni, lui répondit l''aveugle, que je recouvre la vue.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ምን ላደርግልህ ትወዳለህ? አለው። ዕውሩም። መምህር ሆይ፥ አይ ዘንድ አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verses.fr: Et Jésus lui dit: Va, ta foi t''a sauvé. Aussitôt il recouvra la vue, et suivit Jésus dans le chemin.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሂድ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው። ወዲያውም አየ በመንገድም ተከተለው።

verses.en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils approchèrent de Jérusalem, et qu''ils furent près de Bethphagé et de Béthanie, vers la montagne des oliviers, Jésus envoya deux de ses disciples,
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ከደብረ ዘይት አጠገብ ወዳሉቱ ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ልኮ።

verses.en: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
verses.fr: en leur disant: Allez au village qui est devant vous; dès que vous y serez entrés, vous trouverez un ânon attaché, sur lequel aucun homme ne s''est encore assis; détachez-le, et amenez-le.
verses.am: በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ ወዲያውም ወደ እርስዋ ገብታችሁ ከሰው ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ፤ ፈትታችሁ አምጡልኝ።

verses.en: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un vous dit: Pourquoi faites-vous cela? répondez: Le Seigneur en a besoin. Et à l''instant il le laissera venir ici.
verses.am: ማንም። ስለ ምን እንዲህ ታደርጋላችሁ? ቢላችሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል በሉት፥ ወዲያውም ደግሞ ወደዚህ ይሰደዋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
verses.fr: les disciples, étant allés, trouvèrent l''ânon attaché dehors près d''une porte, au contour du chemin, et ils le détachèrent.
verses.am: ሄዱም ውርንጫውንም በመንገድ መተላለፊያ በደጅ ውጭ ታስሮ አገኙት፥ ፈቱትም።

verses.en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
verses.fr: Quelques-uns de ceux qui étaient là leur dirent: Que faites-vous? pourquoi détachez-vous cet ânon?
verses.am: በዚያም ከቆሙት አንዳንዶቹ። ውርንጫውን የምትፈቱት ምን ልታደርጉት ነው አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent comme Jésus l''avait dit. Et on les laissa aller.
verses.am: እነርሱም ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዘ አሉአቸው፤ ተዉአቸውም።

verses.en: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
verses.fr: Ils amenèrent à Jésus l''ânon, sur lequel ils jetèrent leurs vêtements, et Jésus s''assit dessus.
verses.am: ውርንጫውንም ወደ ኢየሱስ አመጡት፥ ልብሳቸውንም በላዩ ጣሉ፥ ተቀመጠበትም።

verses.en: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de gens étendirent leurs vêtements sur le chemin, et d''autres des branches qu''ils coupèrent dans les champs.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎችም ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ላይ አነጠፉ፥ ሌሎችም ከዛፍ ቅጠሎችን እየቈረጡ ያነጥፉ ነበር።

verses.en: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verses.fr: Ceux qui précédaient et ceux qui suivaient Jésus criaient: Hosanna! Béni soit celui qui vient au nom du Seigneur!
verses.am: የሚቀድሙትም የሚከተሉትም። ሆሣዕና፤ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው፤

verses.en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
verses.fr: Béni soit le règne qui vient, le règne de David, notre père! Hosanna dans les lieux très hauts!
verses.am: በጌታ ስም የምትመጣ የአባታችን የዳዊት መንግሥት የተባረከች ናት፤ ሆሣዕና በአርያም እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
verses.fr: Jésus entra à Jérusalem, dans le temple. Quand il eut tout considéré, comme il était déjà tard, il s''en alla à Béthanie avec les douze.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ መቅደስ ገባ፤ ዘወር ብሎም ሁሉን ከተመለከተ በኋላ፥ ጊዜው መሽቶ ስለ ነበረ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ጋር ወደ ቢታንያ ወጣ።

verses.en: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
verses.fr: Le lendemain, après qu''ils furent sortis de Béthanie, Jésus eut faim.
verses.am: በማግሥቱም ከቢታንያ ሲወጡ ተራበ።

verses.en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
verses.fr: Apercevant de loin un figuier qui avait des feuilles, il alla voir s''il y trouverait quelque chose; et, s''en étant approché, il ne trouva que des feuilles, car ce n''était pas la saison des figues.
verses.am: ቅጠልም ያላት በለስ ከሩቅ አይቶ ምናልባት አንዳች ይገኝባት እንደ ሆነ ብሎ መጣ፥ ነገር ግን የበለስ ወራት አልነበረምና መጥቶ ከቅጠል በቀር ምንም አላገኘባትም።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
verses.fr: Prenant alors la parole, il lui dit: Que jamais personne ne mange de ton fruit! Et ses disciples l''entendirent.
verses.am: መልሶም። ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘላለም ማንም ከአንቺ ፍሬ አይብላ አላት። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰሙ።

verses.en: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à Jérusalem, et Jésus entra dans le temple. Il se mit à chasser ceux qui vendaient et qui achetaient dans le temple; il renversa les tables des changeurs, et les sièges des vendeurs de pigeons;
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጡ። ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ በመቅደስ የሚሸጡትንና የሚገዙትን ያወጣ ጀመር፥ የገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ገበታዎች የርግብ ሻጭዎችንም ወንበሮች ገለበጠ፤

verses.en: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
verses.fr: et il ne laissait personne transporter aucun objet à travers le temple.
verses.am: ዕቃም ተሸክሞ ማንም በመቅደስ ሊያልፍ አልፈቀደም።

verses.en: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.fr: Et il enseignait et disait: N''est-il pas écrit: Ma maison sera appelée une maison de prière pour toutes les nations? Mais vous, vous en avez fait une caverne de voleurs.
verses.am: አስተማራቸውም። ቤቴ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የጸሎት ቤት ትባላለች ተብሎ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? እናንተ ግን የወንበዶች ዋሻ አደረጋችኋት አላቸው።

verses.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes, l''ayant entendu, cherchèrent les moyens de le faire périr; car ils le craignaient, parce que toute la foule était frappée de sa doctrine.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችም ጻፎችም ሰምተው፥ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በትምህርቱ ይገረሙ ስለ ነበር ይፈሩት ነበርና እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያጠፉት ፈለጉ።

verses.en: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
verses.fr: Quand le soir fut venu, Jésus sortit de la ville.
verses.am: ማታ ማታም ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ ይወጣ ነበር።

verses.en: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
verses.fr: Le matin, en passant, les disciples virent le figuier séché jusqu''aux racines.
verses.am: ማለዳም ሲያልፉ በለሲቱን ከሥርዋ ደርቃ አዩአት።

verses.en: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
verses.fr: Pierre, se rappelant ce qui s''était passé, dit à Jésus: Rabbi, regarde, le figuier que tu as maudit a séché.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ትዝ ብሎት። መምህር ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ የረገምሃት በለስ ደርቃለች አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
verses.fr: Jésus prit la parole, et leur dit: Ayez foi en Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ።

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, si quelqu''un dit à cette montagne: Ote-toi de là et jette-toi dans la mer, et s''il ne doute point en son coeur, mais croit que ce qu''il dit arrive, il le verra s''accomplir.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ማንም ያለው ነገር እንዲደረግለት ቢያምን በልቡ ሳይጠራጠር፥ ይህን ተራራ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተወርወር ቢል ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous dis: Tout ce que vous demanderez en priant, croyez que vous l''avez reçu, et vous le verrez s''accomplir.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ የጸለያችሁትን የለመናችሁትንም ሁሉ እንዳገኛችሁት እመኑ፥ ይሆንላችሁማል።

verses.en: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
verses.fr: Et, lorsque vous êtes debout faisant votre prière, si vous avez quelque chose contre quelqu''un, pardonnez, afin que votre Père qui est dans les cieux vous pardonne aussi vos offenses.
verses.am: ለጸሎትም በቆማችሁ ጊዜ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ደግሞ ኃጢአታችሁን ይቅር እንዲላችሁ፥ በማንም ላይ አንዳች ቢኖርባችሁ ይቅር በሉት።

verses.en: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
verses.fr: Mais si vous ne pardonnez pas, votre Père qui est dans les cieux ne vous pardonnera pas non plus vos offenses.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ይቅር ባትሉ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁም ኃጢአታችሁን ይቅር አይላችሁም።

verses.en: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
verses.fr: Ils se rendirent de nouveau à Jérusalem, et, pendant que Jésus se promenait dans le temple, les principaux sacrificateurs, les scribes et les anciens, vinrent à lui,
verses.am: ደግሞም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ። እርሱም በመቅደስ ሲመላለስ፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ሽማግሌዎችም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው።

verses.en: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
verses.fr: et lui dirent: Par quelle autorité fais-tu ces choses, et qui t''a donné l''autorité de les faire?
verses.am: እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን ታደርጋለህ? ወይስ እነዚህን ለማድረግ ይህን ሥልጣን ማን ሰጠህ? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Je vous adresserai aussi une question; répondez-moi, et je vous dirai par quelle autorité je fais ces choses.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔም አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም መልሱልኝ፥ እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ እነግራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
verses.fr: Le baptême de Jean venait-il du ciel, ou des hommes? Répondez-moi.
verses.am: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከሰማይ ነበረችን ወይስ ከሰው? መልሱልኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.fr: Mais ils raisonnèrent ainsi entre eux: Si nous répondons: Du ciel, il dira: Pourquoi donc n''avez-vous pas cru en lui?
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ነው ብንል። እንግዲያውስ ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤

verses.en: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
verses.fr: Et si nous répondons: Des hommes... Ils craignaient le peuple, car tous tenaient réellement Jean pour un prophète.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ከሰው ነው እንበልን? አሉ፤ ሁሉ ዮሐንስን በእውነት እንደ ነቢይ ያዩት ነበርና ሕዝቡን ፈሩ።

verses.en: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.fr: Alors ils répondirent à Jésus: Nous ne savons. Et Jésus leur dit: Moi non plus, je ne vous dirai pas par quelle autorité je fais ces choses.
verses.am: ለኢየሱስም መልሰው። አናውቅም አሉት ኢየሱስም። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
verses.fr: Jésus se mit ensuite à leur parler en paraboles. Un homme planta une vigne. Il l''entoura d''une haie, creusa un pressoir, et bâtit une tour; puis il l''afferma à des vignerons, et quitta le pays.
verses.am: በምሳሌም ይነግራቸው ጀመር። አንድ ሰው የወይን አትክልት ተከለ፥ ቅጥርም ቀጠረለት፥ መጥመቂያም ማሰለት፥ ግንብም ሠራና ለገበሬዎች አከራይቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.fr: Au temps de la récolte, il envoya un serviteur vers les vignerons, pour recevoir d''eux une part du produit de la vigne.
verses.am: በጊዜውም ከወይን አትክልት ፍሬ ከገበሬዎቹ እንዲቀበል አንድ ባሪያ ወደ ገበሬዎቹ ላከ፤

verses.en: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.fr: S''étant saisis de lui, ils le battirent, et le renvoyèrent à vide.
verses.am: ይዘውም ደበደቡት ባዶውንም ሰደዱት።

verses.en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
verses.fr: Il envoya de nouveau vers eux un autre serviteur; ils le frappèrent à la tête, et l''outragèrent.
verses.am: ዳግመኛም ሌላውን ባሪያ ወደ እነርሱ ላከ እርሱንም ወግረው ራሱን አቈሰሉት አዋርደውም ሰደዱት።

verses.en: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.fr: Il en envoya un troisième, qu''ils tuèrent; puis plusieurs autres, qu''ils battirent ou tuèrent.
verses.am: ሌላውንም ላከ፤ እርሱንም ገደሉት፥ ከሌሎችም ከብዙዎች አንዳንዱን ደበደቡ አንዳንዱንም ገደሉ።

verses.en: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.fr: Il avait encore un fils bien-aimé; il l''envoya vers eux le dernier, en disant: Ils auront du respect pour mon fils.
verses.am: የሚወደው አንድ ልጅ ገና ነበረው፤ ልጄንስ ያፍሩታል ብሎ እርሱን ከሁሉ በኋላ ወደ እነርሱ ላከ።

verses.en: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.'
verses.fr: Mais ces vignerons dirent entre eux: Voici l''héritier; venez, tuons-le, et l''héritage sera à nous.
verses.am: እነዚያ ገበሬዎች ግን እርስ በርሳቸው። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ኑ፥ እንግደለው፥ ርስቱም ለኛ ይሆናል ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.fr: Et ils se saisirent de lui, le tuèrent, et le jetèrent hors de la vigne.
verses.am: ይዘውም ገደሉት፥ ከወይኑም አትክልት ወደ ውጭ ጣሉት።

verses.en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.fr: Maintenant, que fera le maître de la vigne? Il viendra, fera périr les vignerons, et il donnera la vigne à d''autres.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ ምን ያደርጋል? ይመጣል ገበሬዎቹንም ያጠፋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ለሌሎች ይሰጣል።

verses.en: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
verses.fr: N''avez-vous pas lu cette parole de l''Ecriture: La pierre qu''ont rejetée ceux qui bâtissaient Est devenue la principale de l''angle;
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ስለ እነርሱ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀዋልና ሊይዙት ፈለጉ፥ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ። ትተውትም ሄዱ።

verses.en: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.fr: C''est par la volonté du Seigneur qu''elle l''est devenue, Et c''est un prodige à nos yeux?
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ስለ እነርሱ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀዋልና ሊይዙት ፈለጉ፥ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ። ትተውትም ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.fr: Ils cherchaient à se saisir de lui, mais ils craignaient la foule. Ils avaient compris que c''était pour eux que Jésus avait dit cette parabole. Et ils le quittèrent, et s''en allèrent.
verses.am: በንግግርም ሊያጠምዱት ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሄሮድስ ወገን የሆኑትን ወደ እርሱ ላኩ።

verses.en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
verses.fr: Ils envoyèrent auprès de Jésus quelques-uns des pharisiens et des hérodiens, afin de le surprendre par ses propres paroles.
verses.am: መጥተውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ የሰውን ፊት ሳትመለከት በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ታስተምራለህና እውነተኛ እንደ ሆንህ ለማንምም እንዳታደላ እናውቃለን፤ ለቄሣር ግብር መስጠት ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? እንስጥን ወይስ አንስጥ? አሉት።

verses.en: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.fr: Et ils vinrent lui dire: Maître, nous savons que tu es vrai, et que tu ne t''inquiètes de personne; car tu ne regardes pas à l''apparence des hommes, et tu enseignes la voie de Dieu selon la vérité. Est-il permis, ou non, de payer le tribut à César?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ግብዝነታቸውን አውቆ። ለምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ? አየው ዘንድ አንድ ዲናር አምጡልኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
verses.fr: Devons-nous payer, ou ne pas payer? Jésus, connaissant leur hypocrisie, leur répondit: Pourquoi me tentez-vous? Apportez-moi un denier, afin que je le voie.
verses.am: እነርሱም አመጡለት። ይህች መልክ ጽሕፈቲቱስ የማን ናት? አላቸው፤ እነርሱም። የቄሣር ናት አሉት።

verses.en: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
verses.fr: Ils en apportèrent un; et Jésus leur demanda: De qui sont cette effigie et cette inscription? De César, lui répondirent-ils.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው። በእርሱም ተደነቁ።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.fr: Alors il leur dit: Rendez à César ce qui est à César, et à Dieu ce qui est à Dieu. Et ils furent à son égard dans l''étonnement.
verses.am: ትንሣኤ ሙታን የለም የሚሉ ሰዱቃውያን ወደ እርሱ መጥተው ጠየቁት እንዲህም አሉት።

verses.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.fr: Les sadducéens, qui disent qu''il n''y a point de résurrection, vinrent auprès de Jésus, et lui firent cette question:
verses.am: መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ። የአንድ ሰው ወንድም ሚስቱን ትቶ ልጅ ሳያስቀር ቢሞት፥ ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ ብሎ ጻፈልን።

verses.en: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.fr: Maître, voici ce que Moïse nous a prescrit: Si le frère de quelqu''un meurt, et laisse une femme, sans avoir d''enfants, son frère épousera sa veuve, et suscitera une postérité à son frère.
verses.am: ሰባት ወንድማማቾች ነበሩ፤ ፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ዘር ሳያስቀር ሞተ፤

verses.en: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.fr: Or, il y avait sept frères. Le premier se maria, et mourut sans laisser de postérité.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም አገባት፥ ዘርም ሳይተው ሞተ፤ ሦስተኛውም እንዲሁ፤

verses.en: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.fr: Le second prit la veuve pour femme, et mourut sans laisser de postérité. Il en fut de même du troisième,
verses.am: ሰባቱም አገቡአት፥ ዘርም አላስቀሩም። ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።

verses.en: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.fr: et aucun des sept ne laissa de postérité. Après eux tous, la femme mourut aussi.
verses.am: ሰባቱ አግብተዋታልና በትንሣኤ ቀን ሲነሡ ከእነርሱ ለማናቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?

verses.en: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.fr: A la résurrection, duquel d''entre eux sera-t-elle la femme? Car les sept l''ont eue pour femme.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መጻሕፍትንና የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል አታውቁምና ስለዚህ የምትስቱ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: N''êtes-vous pas dans l''erreur, parce que vous ne comprenez ni les Ecritures, ni la puissance de Dieu?
verses.am: ከሙታንስ ሲነሡ በሰማያት እንዳሉ መላእክት ይሆናሉ እንጂ አያገቡም፥ አይጋቡምም።

verses.en: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.fr: Car, à la résurrection des morts, les hommes ne prendront point de femmes, ni les femmes de maris, mais ils seront comme les anges dans les cieux.
verses.am: ስለ ሙታን ግን እንዲነሡ እግዚአብሔር። እኔ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ነኝ እንዳለው በሙሴ መጽሐፍ በቍጥቋጦው ዘንድ የተጻፈውን አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.en: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.fr: Pour ce qui est de la résurrection des morts, n''avez-vous pas lu, dans le livre de Moïse, ce que Dieu lui dit, à propos du buisson: Je suis le Dieu d''Abraham, le Dieu d''Isaac, et le Dieu de Jacob?
verses.am: የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም። እንግዲህ እጅግ ትስታላችሁ።

verses.en: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.fr: Dieu n''est pas Dieu des morts, mais des vivants. Vous êtes grandement dans l''erreur.
verses.am: ከጻፎችም አንዱ ቀርቦ ሲከራከሩ ሰማና መልካም አድርጎ እንደ መለሰላቸው አስተውሎ። ከሁሉ ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ማናቸይቱ ናት? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.fr: Un des scribes, qui les avait entendus discuter, sachant que Jésus avait bien répondu aux sadducéens, s''approcha, et lui demanda: Quel est le premier de tous les commandements?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። ከትእዛዛቱ ሁሉ ፊተኛይቱ። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ ጌታ አምላካችን አንድ ጌታ ነው፥
