verses.en: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Voici le premier: Ecoute, Israël, le Seigneur, notre Dieu, est l''unique Seigneur;
verses.am: አንተም በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ በፍጹምም አሳብህ በፍጹምም ኃይልህ ጌታ አምላክህን ውደድ የምትል ናት። ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ይህች ናት።

verses.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.fr: et: Tu aimeras le Seigneur, ton Dieu, de tout ton coeur, de toute ton âme, de toute ta pensée, et de toute ta force.
verses.am: ሁለተኛይቱም። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ ውደድ የምትል እርስዋን የምትመስል ይህች ናት። ከእነዚህ የምትበልጥ ሌላ ትእዛዝ የለችም።

verses.en: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.fr: Voici le second: Tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même. Il n''y a pas d''autre commandement plus grand que ceux-là.
verses.am: ጻፊውም። መልካም ነው፥ መምህር ሆይ፤ አንድ ነው ከእርሱም በቀር ሌላ የለም ብለህ በእውነት ተናገርህ፤

verses.en: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.fr: Le scribe lui dit: Bien, maître; tu as dit avec vérité que Dieu est unique, et qu''il n''y en a point d''autre que lui,
verses.am: በፍጹም ልብ በፍጹም አእምሮም በፍጹም ነፍስም በፍጹም ኃይልም እርሱን መውደድ፥ ባልንጀራንም እንደ ራስ መውደድ በሙሉ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ከሌላው መሥዋዕት ሁሉ የሚበልጥ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.fr: et que l''aimer de tout son coeur, de toute sa pensée, de toute son âme et de toute sa force, et aimer son prochain comme soi-même, c''est plus que tous les holocaustes et tous les sacrifices.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በአእምሮ እንደ መለሰ አይቶ። አንተ ከእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የራቅህ አይደለህም አለው። ከዚህም በኋላ ማንም ሊጠይቀው አልደፈረም።

verses.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant qu''il avait répondu avec intelligence, lui dit: Tu n''es pas loin du royaume de Dieu. Et personne n''osa plus lui proposer des questions.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። ጻፎች ክርስቶስ የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ይላሉ?

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?
verses.fr: Jésus, continuant à enseigner dans le temple, dit: Comment les scribes disent-ils que le Christ est fils de David?
verses.am: ዳዊት ራሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ። ጌታ ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው አለ።

verses.en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.fr: David lui-même, animé par l''Esprit-Saint, a dit: Le Seigneur a dit à mon Seigneur: Assieds-toi à ma droite, Jusqu''à ce que je fasse de tes ennemis ton marchepied.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ራሱ ጌታ አለው፤ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል? ብዙ ሕዝብም በደስታ ይሰሙት ነበር።

verses.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.fr: David lui-même l''appelle Seigneur; comment donc est-il son fils? Et une grande foule l''écoutait avec plaisir.
verses.am: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.fr: Il leur disait dans son enseignement: Gardez-vous des scribes, qui aiment à se promener en robes longues, et à être salués dans les places publiques;
verses.am: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ።

verses.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.fr: qui recherchent les premiers sièges dans les synagogues, et les premières places dans les festins;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በመዝገብ አንጻር ተቀምጦ ሕዝቡ በመዝገብ ውስጥ ገንዘብ እንዴት እንዲጥሉ ያይ ነበር፤ ብዙ ባለ ጠጎችም ብዙ ይጥሉ ነበር፤

verses.en: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.fr: qui dévorent les maisons des veuves, et qui font pour l''apparence de longues prières. Ils seront jugés plus sévèrement.
verses.am: አንዲትም ድሀ መበለት መጥታ አንድ ሳንቲም የሚያህሉ ሁለት ናስ ጣለች።

verses.en: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.fr: Jésus, s''étant assis vis-à-vis du tronc, regardait comment la foule y mettait de l''argent. Plusieurs riches mettaient beaucoup.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም ጠርቶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በመዝገብ ውስጥ ከሚጥሉት ሁሉ ይልቅ ይህች ድሀ መበለት አብልጣ ጣለች፤

verses.en: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.fr: Il vint aussi une pauvre veuve, elle y mit deux petites pièces, faisant un quart de sou.
verses.am: ሁሉ ከትርፋቸው ጥለዋልና፥ ይህች ግን ከጕድለትዋ የነበራትን ሁሉ ትዳርዋን ሁሉ ጣለች አላቸው።

verses.en: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.fr: Alors Jésus, ayant appelé ses disciples, leur dit: Je vous le dis en vérité, cette pauvre veuve a donné plus qu''aucun de ceux qui ont mis dans le tronc;
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም ጠርቶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በመዝገብ ውስጥ ከሚጥሉት ሁሉ ይልቅ ይህች ድሀ መበለት አብልጣ ጣለች፤

verses.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.fr: car tous ont mis de leur superflu, mais elle a mis de son nécessaire, tout ce qu''elle possédait, tout ce qu''elle avait pour vivre.
verses.am: ሁሉ ከትርፋቸው ጥለዋልና፥ ይህች ግን ከጕድለትዋ የነበራትን ሁሉ ትዳርዋን ሁሉ ጣለች አላቸው።

verses.en: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus sortit du temple, un de ses disciples lui dit: Maître, regarde quelles pierres, et quelles constructions!
verses.am: እርሱም ከመቅደስ ሲወጣ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ እንዴት ያሉ ድንጋይዎችና እንዴት ያሉ ሕንጻዎች እንደ ሆኑ እይ አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Vois-tu ces grandes constructions? Il ne restera pas pierre sur pierre qui ne soit renversée.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እነዚህን ታላላቅ ሕንጻዎች ታያለህን? ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ አይቀርም አለው።

verses.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.fr: Il s''assit sur la montagne des oliviers, en face du temple. Et Pierre, Jacques, Jean et André lui firent en particulier cette question:
verses.am: በመቅደስም ትይዩ በደብረ ዘይት ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ ጴጥሮስና ያዕቆብ ዮሐንስም እንድርያስም።

verses.en: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.fr: Dis-nous, quand cela arrivera-t-il, et à quel signe connaîtra-t-on que toutes ces choses vont s''accomplir?
verses.am: ንገረን፥ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? ይህስ ሁሉ ይፈጸም ዘንድ እንዳለው ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ለብቻቸው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
verses.fr: Jésus se mit alors à leur dire: Prenez garde que personne ne vous séduise.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ ይላቸው ጀመር። ማንም እንዳያስታችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.fr: Car plusieurs viendront sous mon nom, disant; C''est moi. Et ils séduiront beaucoup de gens.
verses.am: ብዙዎች። እኔ ነኝ እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፥ ብዙዎችንም ያስታሉ።

verses.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
verses.fr: Quand vous entendrez parler de guerres et de bruits de guerres, ne soyez pas troublés, car il faut que ces choses arrivent. Mais ce ne sera pas encore la fin.
verses.am: ጦርንም የጦርንም ወሬ በሰማችሁ ጊዜ አትደንግጡ፤ ይህ ሊሆን ግድ ነውና፥ ነገር ግን መጨረሻው ገና ነው።

verses.en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.fr: Une nation s''élèvera contre une nation, et un royaume contre un royaume; il y aura des tremblements de terre en divers lieux, il y aura des famines. Ce ne sera que le commencement des douleurs.
verses.am: ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣልና፤ በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ የምድር መናወጥ ይሆናል፤ ራብ ይሆናል፤ እነዚህ የምጥ ጣር መጀመሪያ ናቸው።

verses.en: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.fr: Prenez garde à vous-mêmes. On vous livrera aux tribunaux, et vous serez battus de verges dans les synagogues; vous comparaîtrez devant des gouverneurs et devant des rois, à cause de moi, pour leur servir de témoignage.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ወደ ሸንጎ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል በምኵራብም ትገረፋላችሁ ምስክርም ይሆንባቸው ዘንድ ስለ እኔ በገዥዎችና በነገሥታት ፊት ትቆማላችሁ።

verses.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.fr: Il faut premièrement que la bonne nouvelle soit prêchée à toutes les nations.
verses.am: አስቀድሞም ወንጌል ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይሰበክ ዘንድ ይገባል።

verses.en: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Quand on vous emmènera pour vous livrer, ne vous inquiétez pas d''avance de ce que vous aurez à dire, mais dites ce qui vous sera donné à l''heure même; car ce n''est pas vous qui parlerez, mais l''Esprit-Saint.
verses.am: ሲጐትቱአችሁና አሳልፈው ሲሰጡአችሁም ምን እንድትናገሩ አስቀድማችሁ አትጨነቁ፥ ዳሩ ግን በዚያች ሰዓት የሚሰጣችሁን ተናገሩ፤ የሚነግረው መንፈስ ቅዱስ ነው እንጂ እናንተ አይደላችሁምና።

verses.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.fr: Le frère livrera son frère à la mort, et le père son enfant; les enfants se soulèveront contre leurs parents, et les feront mourir.
verses.am: ወንድምም ወንድሙን አባትም ልጁን ለሞት አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ልጆችም በወላጆቻቸው ላይ ይነሣሉ። ይገድሉአቸውማል፤

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.fr: Vous serez haïs de tous, à cause de mon nom, mais celui qui persévérera jusqu''à la fin sera sauvé.
verses.am: በሁሉም ዘንድ ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ፤ እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።

verses.en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.fr: Lorsque vous verrez l''abomination de la désolation établie là où elle ne doit pas être, -que celui qui lit fasse attention, -alors, que ceux qui seront en Judée fuient dans les montagnes;
verses.am: ነገር ግን በነቢዩ በዳንኤል የተባለውን የጥፋት ርኵሰት በማይገባው ስፍራ ቆሞ ብታዩ፥ አንባቢው ያስተውል፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉ ወደ ተራሮች ይሽሹ፥

verses.en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.fr: que celui qui sera sur le toit ne descende pas et n''entre pas pour prendre quelque chose dans sa maison;
verses.am: በሰገነትም ያለ ወደ ቤት አይውረድ ከቤቱም አንዳች ይወስድ ዘንድ አይግባ፥

verses.en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.fr: et que celui qui sera dans les champs ne retourne pas en arrière pour prendre son manteau.
verses.am: በእርሻም ያለ ልብሱን ይወስድ ዘንድ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።

verses.en: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.fr: Malheur aux femmes qui seront enceintes et à celles qui allaiteront en ces jours-là!
verses.am: በዚያን ወራትም ለርጉዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው።

verses.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.fr: Priez pour que ces choses n''arrivent pas en hiver.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሽሽታችሁ በክረምት እንዳይሆን ጸልዩ፤

verses.en: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.fr: Car la détresse, en ces jours, sera telle qu''il n''y en a point eu de semblable depuis le commencement du monde que Dieu a créé jusqu''à présent, et qu''il n''y en aura jamais.
verses.am: በዚያን ወራት እግዚአብሔር ከፈጠረው ከፍጥረት መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ያልሆነ ደግሞም የማይሆን የመከራ ዓይነት ይሆናልና።

verses.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.fr: Et, si le Seigneur n''avait abrégé ces jours, personne ne serait sauvé; mais il les a abrégés, à cause des élus qu''il a choisis.
verses.am: ጌታስ ወራቶቹን ባያሳጥር፥ ሥጋ የለበሰ ሁሉ ባልዳነም፤ ነገር ግን ስለ መረጣቸው ምርጦች ወራቶቹን አሳጠረ።

verses.en: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un vous dit alors: Le Christ est ici, ou: Il est là", ne le croyez pas.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ማንም። እነሆ፥ ክርስቶስ ከዚህ አለ፥ ወይም። እነሆ፥ ከዚያ አለ ቢላችሁ አትመኑ፤

verses.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
verses.fr: Car il s''élèvera de faux Christs et de faux prophètes; ils feront des prodiges et des miracles pour séduire les élus, s''il était possible.
verses.am: ሐሰተኞች ክርስቶሶችና ሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ይነሣሉና፥ ቢቻላቸውስ የተመረጡትን እንኳ ያስቱ ዘንድ ምልክትና ድንቅ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.fr: Soyez sur vos gardes: je vous ai tout annoncé d''avance.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ተጠንቀቁ፤ እነሆ፥ አስቀድሜ ሁሉን ነገርኋችሁ።

verses.en: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.fr: Mais dans ces jours, après cette détresse, le soleil s''obscurcira, la lune ne donnera plus sa lumière,
verses.am: በዚያን ወራት ግን ከዚያ መከራ በኋላ ፀሐይ ይጨልማል ጨረቃም ብርሃንዋን አትሰጥም፥

verses.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.fr: les étoiles tomberont du ciel, et les puissances qui sont dans les cieux seront ébranlées.
verses.am: ከዋክብትም ከሰማይ ይወድቃሉ፥ የሰማያትም ኃይላት ይናወጣሉ።

verses.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.fr: Alors on verra le Fils de l''homme venant sur les nuées avec une grande puissance et avec gloire.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ በብዙ ኃይልና ክብር በደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል።

verses.en: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.fr: Alors il enverra les anges, et il rassemblera les élus des quatre vents, de l''extrémité de la terre jusqu''à l''extrémité du ciel.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም መላእክትን ይልካል ከአራቱ ነፋሳትም ከምድር ዳርቻ እስከ ሰማይ ዳርቻ የተመረጡትን ይሰበስባቸዋል።

verses.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.fr: Instruisez-vous par une comparaison tirée du figuier. Dès que ses branches deviennent tendres, et que les feuilles poussent, vous connaissez que l''été est proche.
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ከበለስ ተማሩ፤ ጫፍዋ ሲለሰልስ ቅጠልዋም ሲያቈጠቍጥ፥ ያን ጊዜ በጋ እንደ ቀረበ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.en: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
verses.fr: De même, quand vous verrez ces choses arriver, sachez que le Fils de l''homme est proche, à la porte.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ እናንተ ይህን ሁሉ መሆኑን ስታዩ ቀርቦ በደጅ እንደ ሆነ እወቁ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, cette génération ne passera point, que tout cela n''arrive.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.fr: Le ciel et la terre passeront, mais mes paroles ne passeront point.
verses.am: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።

verses.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui est du jour ou de l''heure, personne ne le sait, ni les anges dans le ciel, ni le Fils, mais le Père seul.
verses.am: ስለዚያች ቀን ወይም ስለዚያች ሰዓት ግን የሰማይ መላእክትም ቢሆኑ ልጅም ቢሆን ከአባት በቀር የሚያውቅ የለም።

verses.en: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.fr: Prenez garde, veillez et priez; car vous ne savez quand ce temps viendra.
verses.am: ጊዜው መቼ እንዲሆን አታውቁምና ተጠንቀቁ፤ ትጉ፤ ጸልዩም።

verses.en: For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.fr: Il en sera comme d''un homme qui, partant pour un voyage, laisse sa maison, remet l''autorité à ses serviteurs, indique à chacun sa tâche, et ordonne au portier de veiller.
verses.am: ቤቱን ትቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር እንደ ሄደ ሰው ነው፥ ለባሮቹም ሥልጣን ለእያንዳንዱም ሥራውን ሰጥቶ በረኛውን እንዲተጋ አዘዘ።

verses.en: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.fr: Veillez donc, car vous ne savez quand viendra le maître de la maison, ou le soir, ou au milieu de la nuit, ou au chant du coq, ou le matin;
verses.am: እንግዲህ በማታ ቢሆን ወይም በእኩለ ሌሊት ወይም ዶሮ ሲጮኽ ወይም በማለዳ ቢሆን ባለቤቱ መቼ እንዲመጣ አታውቁምና

verses.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.fr: craignez qu''il ne vous trouve endormis, à son arrivée soudaine.
verses.am: ድንገት መጥቶ ተኝታችሁ እንዳያገኛችሁ ስለዚህ ትጉ።

verses.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.fr: Ce que je vous dis, je le dis à tous: Veillez.
verses.am: ለእናንተም የምነግራችሁ ለሁሉ እላለሁ፤ ትጉ።

verses.en: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
verses.fr: La fête de Pâque et des pains sans levain devait avoir lieu deux jours après. Les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes cherchaient les moyens d''arrêter Jésus par ruse, et de le faire mourir.
verses.am: ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ፋሲካና የቂጣ በዓል ነበረ። የካህናት አለቆችም ጻፎችም እንዴት አድርገው በተንኰል እንደሚይዙትና እንደሚገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር።

verses.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.fr: Car ils disaient: Que ce ne soit pas pendant la fête, afin qu''il n''y ait pas de tumulte parmi le peuple.
verses.am: የሕዝብ ሁከት እንዳይሆን በበዓል አይሁን ይሉ ነበርና።

verses.en: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
verses.fr: Comme Jésus était à Béthanie, dans la maison de Simon le lépreux, une femme entra, pendant qu''il se trouvait à table. Elle tenait un vase d''albâtre, qui renfermait un parfum de nard pur de grand prix; et, ayant rompu le vase, elle répandit le parfum sur la tête de Jésus.
verses.am: እርሱም በቢታንያ በለምጻሙ በስምዖን ቤት በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ አንዲት ሴት ዋጋው እጅግ የከበረ ጥሩ ናርዶስ ሽቱ የመላበት የአልባስጥሮስ ቢልቃጥ ይዛ መጣች፤ ቢልቃጡንም ሰብራ በራሱ ላይ አፈሰሰችው።

verses.en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.fr: Quelques-uns exprimèrent entre eux leur indignation: A quoi bon perdre ce parfum?
verses.am: አንዳንዶችም። ይህ የሽቱ ጥፋት ለምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.fr: On aurait pu le vendre plus de trois cents deniers, et les donner aux pauvres. Et ils s''irritaient contre cette femme.
verses.am: ይህ ሽቱ ከሦስት መቶ ዲናር በሚበልጥ ዋጋ ተሽጦ ለድሆች ሊሰጥ ይቻል ነበርና ብለው በራሳቸው ይቈጡ ነበር፤ እርስዋንም ነቀፉአት።

verses.en: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus dit: Laissez-la. Pourquoi lui faites-vous de la peine? Elle a fait une bonne action à mon égard;
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን እንዲህ አለ። ተዉአት፤ ስለ ምን ታደክሙአታላችሁ? መልካም ሥራ ሠርታልኛለች።

verses.en: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.fr: car vous avez toujours les pauvres avec vous, et vous pouvez leur faire du bien quand vous voulez, mais vous ne m''avez pas toujours.
verses.am: ድሆች ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ይኖራሉና፥ በማናቸውም በወደዳችሁት ጊዜ መልካም ልታደርጉላቸው ትችላላችሁ፥ እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር አልኖርም።

verses.en: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.fr: Elle a fait ce qu''elle a pu; elle a d''avance embaumé mon corps pour la sépulture.
verses.am: የተቻላትን አደረገች፤ አስቀድማ ለመቃብሬ ሥጋዬን ቀባችው።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, partout où la bonne nouvelle sera prêchée, dans le monde entier, on racontera aussi en mémoire de cette femme ce qu''elle a fait.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ወንጌል በዓለሙ ሁሉ በሚሰበክበት በማናቸውም ስፍራ፥ እርስዋ ያደረገችው ደግሞ ለእርስዋ መታሰቢያ ሊሆን ይነገራል።

verses.en: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.fr: Judas Iscariot, l''un des douze, alla vers les principaux sacrificateurs, afin de leur livrer Jésus.
verses.am: ከአሥራ ሁለቱም አንዱ የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ አሳልፎ ሊሰጠው ወደ ካህናት አለቆች ሄደ።

verses.en: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir entendu, ils furent dans la joie, et promirent de lui donner de l''argent. Et Judas cherchait une occasion favorable pour le livrer.
verses.am: ሲሰሙም ደስ አላቸው ብርም ይሰጡት ዘንድ ተስፋ ሰጡት። በሚመች ጊዜም እንዴት አድርጎ አሳልፎ እንዲሰጠው ይፈልግ ነበር።

verses.en: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
verses.fr: Le premier jour des pains sans levain, où l''on immolait la Pâque, les disciples de Jésus lui dirent: Où veux-tu que nous allions te préparer la Pâque?
verses.am: ፋሲካን በሚያርዱበት በቂጣ በዓል መጀመሪያ ቀን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ፋሲካን ትበላ ዘንድ ወዴት ሄደን ልናሰናዳ ትወዳለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.fr: Et il envoya deux de ses disciples, et leur dit: Allez à la ville; vous rencontrerez un homme portant une cruche d''eau, suivez-le.
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሁለት ላከ እንዲህም አላቸው። ወደ ከተማ ሂዱ፥ ማድጋ ውኃ የተሸከመ ሰውም ይገናኛችኋል፤

verses.en: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.fr: Quelque part qu''il entre, dites au maître de la maison: Le maître dit: Où est le lieu où je mangerai la Pâque avec mes disciples?
verses.am: ተከተሉት፥ የሚገባበትንም የቤቱን ጌታ። መምህሩ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ፋሲካን የምበላበት የእንግዳ ቤት ወዴት ነው? ይላል በሉት።

verses.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.fr: Et il vous montrera une grande chambre haute, meublée et toute prête: c''est là que vous nous préparerez la Pâque.
verses.am: እርሱም በደርብ ላይ ያለውን የተሰናዳና የተነጠፈ ታላቅ አዳራሽ ያሳያችኋል፤

verses.en: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.fr: Les disciples partirent, arrivèrent à la ville, et trouvèrent les choses comme il le leur avait dit; et ils préparèrent la Pâque.
verses.am: በዚያም አሰናዱልን። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወጡ ወደ ከተማም ሄደው እንዳላቸው አገኙ፥ ፋሲካንም አሰናዱ።

verses.en: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.fr: Le soir étant venu, il arriva avec les douze.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ጋር መጣ።

verses.en: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils étaient à table et qu''ils mangeaient, Jésus dit: Je vous le dis en vérité, l''un de vous, qui mange avec moi, me livrera.
verses.am: ተቀምጠውም ሲበሉ ኢየሱስ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ አንዱ፥ እርሱም ከእኔ ጋር የሚበላው አሳልፎ ይሰጠኛል አለ።

verses.en: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
verses.fr: Ils commencèrent à s''attrister, et à lui dire, l''un après l''autre: Est-ce moi?
verses.am: እነርሱም ያዝኑ፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም። እኔ እሆንን? ይሉት ጀመር።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: C''est l''un des douze, qui met avec moi la main dans le plat.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ወጭቱ እጁን የሚያጠልቀው ነው።

verses.en: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.fr: Le Fils de l''homme s''en va selon ce qui est écrit de lui. Mais malheur à l''homme par qui le Fils de l''homme est livré! Mieux vaudrait pour cet homme qu''il ne fût pas né.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅስ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይሄዳል፤ ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት፤ ያ ሰው ባልተወለደ ይሻለው ነበር አላቸው።

verses.en: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils mangeaient, Jésus prit du pain; et, après avoir rendu grâces, il le rompit, et le leur donna, en disant: Prenez, ceci est mon corps.
verses.am: ሲበሉም ኢየሱስ እንጀራን አንሥቶ ባረከ ቈርሶም ሰጣቸውና። እንካችሁ፤ ይህ ሥጋዬ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.fr: Il prit ensuite une coupe; et, après avoir rendu grâces, il la leur donna, et ils en burent tous.
verses.am: ጽዋንም አንሥቶ አመስግኖም ሰጣቸው፥ ሁሉም ከእርሱ ጠጡ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Ceci est mon sang, le sang de l''alliance, qui est répandu pour plusieurs.
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህ ስለ ብዙዎች የሚፈስ የአዲስ ኪዳን ደሜ ነው።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, je ne boirai plus jamais du fruit de la vigne, jusqu''au jour où je le boirai nouveau dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከወይኑ ፍሬ አዲሱን እስከምጠጣበት እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ደግሞ አልጠጣውም አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.fr: Après avoir chanté les cantiques, ils se rendirent à la montagne des oliviers.
verses.am: መዝሙርም ከዘመሩ በኋላ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ወጡ።

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Vous serez tous scandalisés; car il est écrit: Je frapperai le berger, et les brebis seront dispersées.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። በዚች ሌሊት ሁላችሁ በእኔ ትሰናከላላችሁ፤ እረኛዉን እመታለሁ በጎችም ይበተናሉ የሚል ተጽፎአልና።

verses.en: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.fr: Mais, après que je serai ressuscité, je vous précéderai en Galilée.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከተነሣሁ በኋላ ወደ ገሊላ እቀድማችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
verses.fr: Pierre lui dit: Quand tous seraient scandalisés, je ne serai pas scandalisé.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። ሁሉም ቢሰናከሉ እኔ ግን ከቶ አልሰናከልም አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.fr: Et Jésus lui dit: Je te le dis en vérité, toi, aujourd''hui, cette nuit même, avant que le coq chante deux fois, tu me renieras trois fois.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ዛሬ በዚች ሌሊት ዶሮ ሁለት ጊዜ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ አለው።

verses.en: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.fr: Mais Pierre reprit plus fortement: Quand il me faudrait mourir avec toi, je ne te renierai pas. Et tous dirent la même chose.
verses.am: እርሱም ቃሉን አበርትቶ። ከአንተ ጋር የምሞት እንኳ ቢሆን ከቶ አልክድህም አለ። ሁሉም ደግሞ እንደዚሁ አሉ።

verses.en: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
verses.fr: Ils allèrent ensuite dans un lieu appelé Gethsémané, et Jésus dit à ses disciples: Asseyez-vous ici, pendant que je prierai.
verses.am: ጌቴሴማኒ ወደምትባልም ስፍራ መጡ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም። ስጸልይ ሳለሁ፥ በዚህ ተቀመጡ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.fr: Il prit avec lui Pierre, Jacques et Jean, et il commença à éprouver de la frayeur et des angoisses.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስንና ያዕቆብን ዮሐንስንም ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፤ ሊደነግጥም ሊተክዝም ጀመረና።

verses.en: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Mon âme est triste jusqu''à la mort; restez ici, et veillez.
verses.am: ነፍሴ እስከ ሞት ድረስ እጅግ አዘነች፤ በዚህ ቈዩ ትጉም አላቸው።

verses.en: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.fr: Puis, ayant fait quelques pas en avant, il se jeta contre terre, et pria que, s''il était possible, cette heure s''éloignât de lui.
verses.am: ጥቂትም ወደ ፊት እልፍ ብሎ በምድርም ወድቆ፥ ይቻልስ ቢሆን ሰዓቲቱ ከእርሱ እንድታልፍ ጸለየና።

verses.en: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.fr: Il disait: Abba, Père, toutes choses te sont possibles, éloigne de moi cette coupe! Toutefois, non pas ce que je veux, mais ce que tu veux.
verses.am: አባ አባት ሆይ፥ ሁሉ ይቻልሃል፤ ይህችን ጽዋ ከእኔ ውሰድ፤ ነገር ግን አንተ የምትወደው እንጂ እኔ የምወደው አይሁን አለ።

verses.en: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
verses.fr: Et il vint vers les disciples, qu''il trouva endormis, et il dit à Pierre: Simon, tu dors! Tu n''as pu veiller une heure!
verses.am: መጣም ተኝተውም አገኛቸው፥ ጴጥሮስንም። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ተኝተሃልን? አንዲት ሰዓት ስንኳ ልትተጋ አልቻልህምን?

verses.en: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
verses.fr: Veillez et priez, afin que vous ne tombiez pas en tentation; l''esprit est bien disposé, mais la chair est faible.
verses.am: ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ትጉ ጸልዩም፤ መንፈስስ ተዘጋጅታለች፥ ሥጋ ግን ደካማ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.fr: Il s''éloigna de nouveau, et fit la même prière.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሄዶ ያንኑ ቃል ጸለየ።

verses.en: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.fr: Il revint, et les trouva encore endormis; car leurs yeux étaient appesantis. Ils ne surent que lui répondre.
verses.am: ደግሞም መጥቶ ዓይኖቻቸው በእንቅልፍ ከብደው ነበርና ተኝተው አገኛቸው፥ የሚመልሱለትንም አላወቁም።

verses.en: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.fr: Il revint pour la troisième fois, et leur dit: Dormez maintenant, et reposez-vous! C''est assez! L''heure est venue; voici, le Fils de l''homme est livré aux mains des pécheurs.
verses.am: ሦስተኛም መጥቶ። እንግዲህስ ተኙ ዕረፉም፤ ይበቃል፤ ሰዓቲቱ ደረሰች፤ እነሆ፥ የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.fr: Levez-vous, allons; voici, celui qui me livre s''approche.
verses.am: ተነሡ፥ እንሂድ፤ እነሆ፥ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ ቀርቦአል አላቸው።

verses.en: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.fr: Et aussitôt, comme il parlait encore, arriva Judas l''un des douze, et avec lui une foule armée d''épées et de bâtons, envoyée par les principaux sacrificateurs, par les scribes et par les anciens.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ገና ሲናገር ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ይሁዳ መጣ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ብዙ ሰዎች ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዘው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከጻፎች ከሽማግሌዎችም ዘንድ መጡ።

verses.en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
verses.fr: Celui qui le livrait leur avait donné ce signe: Celui que je baiserai, c''est lui; saisissez-le, et emmenez-le sûrement.
verses.am: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም። የምስመው እርሱ ነው፤ ያዙት ተጠንቅቃችሁም ውሰዱት ብሎ ምልክት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.fr: Dès qu''il fut arrivé, il s''approcha de Jésus, disant: Rabbi! Et il le baisa.
verses.am: መጥቶም ወዲያው ወደ እርሱ ቀረበና። መምህር ሆይ፥ መምህር ሆይ፥ ብሎ ሳመው፤

verses.en: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.fr: Alors ces gens mirent la main sur Jésus, et le saisirent.
verses.am: እነርሱም እጃቸውን በእርሱ ላይ ጭነው ያዙት።

verses.en: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.fr: Un de ceux qui étaient là, tirant l''épée, frappa le serviteur du souverain sacrificateur, et lui emporta l''oreille.
verses.am: በአጠገብ ከቆሙት ግን አንዱ ሰይፉን መዞ የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መታ ጆሮውንም ቈረጠ።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
verses.fr: Jésus, prenant la parole, leur dit: Vous êtes venus, comme après un brigand, avec des épées et des bâtons, pour vous emparer de moi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ወንበዴ እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ልትይዙኝ መጣችሁን?

verses.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.fr: J''étais tous les jours parmi vous, enseignant dans le temple, et vous ne m''avez pas saisi. Mais c''est afin que les Ecritures soient accomplies.
verses.am: በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት እያስተማርሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ስኖር አልያዛችሁኝም፤ ነገር ግን መጻሕፍት ይፈጸሙ ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.fr: Alors tous l''abandonnèrent, et prirent la fuite.
verses.am: ሁሉም ትተውት ሸሹ።

verses.en: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.fr: Un jeune homme le suivait, n''ayant sur le corps qu''un drap. On se saisit de lui;
verses.am: ዕርቃኑን በነጠላ የሸፈነ አንድ ጎበዝ ይከተለው ነበር፥

verses.en: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.fr: mais il lâcha son vêtement, et se sauva tout nu.
verses.am: ጎበዛዝቱም ያዙት፤ እርሱ ግን ነጠላውን ትቶ ዕራቁቱን ሸሸ።

verses.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.fr: Ils emmenèrent Jésus chez le souverain sacrificateur, où s''assemblèrent tous les principaux sacrificateurs, les anciens et les scribes.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወሰዱት፥ የካህናት አለቆችም ሁሉ ሽማግሌዎችም ጻፎችም ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.fr: Pierre le suivit de loin jusque dans l''intérieur de la cour du souverain sacrificateur; il s''assit avec les serviteurs, et il se chauffait près du feu.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም እስከ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ግቢ ውስጥ በሩቁ ተከተለው፥ ከሎሌዎችም ጋር ተቀምጦ እሳት ይሞቅ ነበር።

verses.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et tout le sanhédrin cherchaient un témoignage contre Jésus, pour le faire mourir, et ils n''en trouvaient point;
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችም ሸንጎውም ሁሉ እንዲገድሉት በኢየሱስ ላይ ምስክር ይፈልጉ ነበር፥ አላገኙምም፤

verses.en: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.fr: car plusieurs rendaient de faux témoignages contre lui, mais les témoignages ne s''accordaient pas.
verses.am: ብዙዎች በሐሰት ይመሰክሩበት ነበርና፥ ምስክርነታቸው ግን አልተሰማማም።

verses.en: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.fr: Quelques-uns se levèrent, et portèrent un faux témoignage contre lui, disant:
verses.am: ምስክርነታቸውም እንዲሁ እንኳ አልተሰማማም።

verses.en: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.fr: Nous l''avons entendu dire: Je détruirai ce temple fait de main d''homme, et en trois jours j''en bâtirai un autre qui ne sera pas fait de main d''homme.
verses.am: ምስክርነታቸውም እንዲሁ እንኳ አልተሰማማም።

verses.en: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.fr: Même sur ce point-là leur témoignage ne s''accordait pas.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱም በመካከላቸው ተነሥቶ። አንዳች አትመልስምን? እነዚህስ በአንተ ላይ የሚመሰክሩብህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ኢየሱስን ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.fr: Alors le souverain sacrificateur, se levant au milieu de l''assemblée, interrogea Jésus, et dit: Ne réponds-tu rien? Qu''est-ce que ces gens déposent contre toi?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ዝም አለ አንዳችም አልመለሰም። ደግሞ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ጠየቀውና። የቡሩክ ልጅ ክርስቶስ አንተ ነህን? አለው።

verses.en: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.fr: Jésus garda le silence, et ne répondit rien. Le souverain sacrificateur l''interrogea de nouveau, et lui dit: Es-tu le Christ, le Fils du Dieu béni?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔ ነኝ፤ የሰው ልጅም በኃይል ቀኝ ሲቀመጥ በሰማይም ደመና ሲመጣ ታያላችሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Je le suis. Et vous verrez le Fils de l''homme assis à la droite de la puissance de Dieu, et venant sur les nuées du ciel.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ልብሱን ቀደደና። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምስክሮችን ምን ያስፈልገናል?

verses.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
verses.fr: Alors le souverain sacrificateur déchira ses vêtements, et dit: Qu''avons-nous encore besoin de témoins?
verses.am: ስድቡን ሰማችሁ፤ ምን ይመስላችኋል? አለ። እነርሱም ሁሉ። ሞት ይገባዋል ብለው ፈረዱበት።

verses.en: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
verses.fr: Vous avez entendu le blasphème. Que vous en semble? Tous le condamnèrent comme méritant la mort.
verses.am: አንዳንዶችም ይተፉበት ፊቱንም ሸፍነው ይጐስሙትና። ትንቢት ተናገር ይሉት ጀመር፤ ሎሌዎችም በጥፊ እየመቱ ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
verses.fr: Et quelques-uns se mirent à cracher sur lui, à lui voiler le visage et à le frapper à coups de poing, en lui disant: Devine! Et les serviteurs le reçurent en lui donnant des soufflets.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም በግቢ ውስጥ ወደ ታች ሳለ ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ገረዶች አንዲቱ መጣች፥

verses.en: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
verses.fr: Pendant que Pierre était en bas dans la cour, il vint une des servantes du souverain sacrificateur.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም እሳት ሲሞቅ አይታ ተመለከተችውና። አንተ ደግሞ ከናዝሬቱ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ነበርህ አለችው።

verses.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.fr: Voyant Pierre qui se chauffait, elle le regarda, et lui dit: Toi aussi, tu étais avec Jésus de Nazareth.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። የምትዪውን አላውቅም አላስተውልምም ብሎ ካደ። ወደ ውጭም ወደ ደጅ ወጣ፤ ዶሮም ጮኸ።

verses.en: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.fr: Il le nia, disant: Je ne sais pas, je ne comprends pas ce que tu veux dire. Puis il sortit pour aller dans le vestibule. Et le coq chanta.
verses.am: ገረዲቱም አይታው በዚያ ለቆሙት። ይህም ከእነርሱ ወገን ነው ስትል ሁለተኛ ትነግራቸው ጀመር።

verses.en: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
verses.fr: La servante, l''ayant vu, se mit de nouveau à dire à ceux qui étaient présents: Celui-ci est de ces gens-là.
verses.am: እርሱም ደግሞ ካደ። ጥቂት ቈይተውም በዚያ የቆሙት ዳግመኛ ጴጥሮስን። የገሊላ ሰው ነህና ከእነርሱ ወገን በእውነት ነህ አሉት።

verses.en: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
verses.fr: Et il le nia de nouveau. Peu après, ceux qui étaient présents dirent encore à Pierre: Certainement tu es de ces gens-là, car tu es Galiléen.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ይህን የምትሉትን ሰው አላውቀውም ብሎ ይረገምና ይምል ጀመር። ወዲያውም ዶሮ ሁለተኛ ጮኸ።

verses.en: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.fr: Alors il commença à faire des imprécations et à jurer: Je ne connais pas cet homme dont vous parlez.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስንም ኢየሱስ። ዶሮ ሁለት ጊዜ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ ያለው ቃል ትዝ አለው፤ ነገሩንም አስቦ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
verses.fr: Aussitôt, pour la seconde fois, le coq chanta. Et Pierre se souvint de la parole que Jésus lui avait dite: Avant que le coq chante deux fois, tu me renieras trois fois. Et en y réfléchissant, il pleurait.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስንም ኢየሱስ። ዶሮ ሁለት ጊዜ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ ያለው ቃል ትዝ አለው፤ ነገሩንም አስቦ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
verses.fr: Dès le matin, les principaux sacrificateurs tinrent conseil avec les anciens et les scribes, et tout le sanhédrin. Après avoir lié Jésus, ils l''emmenèrent, et le livrèrent à Pilate.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ማለዳ የካህናት አለቆች ከሽማግሌዎችና ከጻፎች ከሸንጎውም ሁሉ ጋር ከተማከሩ በኋላ፥ ኢየሱስን አሳስረው ወሰዱትና ለጲላጦስ አሳልፈው ሰጡት።

verses.en: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto them, Thou sayest it.
verses.fr: Pilate l''interrogea: Es-tu le roi des Juifs? Jésus lui répondit: Tu le dis.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። አንተ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም። አንተ አልህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs portaient contre lui plusieurs accusations.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችም ብዙ ያሳጡት ነበር፤ እርሱ ግን ምንም አልመለሰም።

verses.en: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
verses.fr: Pilate l''interrogea de nouveau: Ne réponds-tu rien? Vois de combien de choses ils t''accusent.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ደግሞ። አንዳች አትመልስምን? እነሆ፥ በስንት ነገር ያሳጡሃል ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
verses.fr: Et Jésus ne fit plus aucune réponse, ce qui étonna Pilate.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ በኋላ ጲላጦስ እስኪደነቅ ድረስ ምንም አልመለሰም።

verses.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
verses.fr: A chaque fête, il relâchait un prisonnier, celui que demandait la foule.
verses.am: በዚያም በዓል የለመኑትን አንድ እስረኛ ይፈታላቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
verses.fr: Il y avait en prison un nommé Barabbas avec ses complices, pour un meurtre qu''ils avaient commis dans une sédition.
verses.am: በዓመፅም ነፍስ ከገደሉት ከዓመፀኞች ጋር የታሰረ በርባን የተባለ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
verses.fr: La foule, étant montée, se mit à demander ce qu''il avait coutume de leur accorder.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወጥተው እንደ ልማዱ ያደርግላቸው ዘንድ እየጮኹ ይለምኑት ጀመር።

verses.en: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.fr: Pilate leur répondit: Voulez-vous que je vous relâche le roi des Juifs?
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። የአይሁድን ንጉሥ እፈታላችሁ ዘንድ ትወዳላችሁን? ብሎ መለሰላቸው፤

verses.en: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
verses.fr: Car il savait que c''était par envie que les principaux sacrificateurs l''avaient livré.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆች በቅንዓት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡት ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.fr: Mais les chefs des sacrificateurs excitèrent la foule, afin que Pilate leur relâchât plutôt Barabbas.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆች ግን በርባንን በእርሱ ፈንታ ይፈታላቸው ዘንድ ሕዝቡን አወኩአቸው።

verses.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.fr: Pilate, reprenant la parole, leur dit: Que voulez-vous donc que je fasse de celui que vous appelez le roi des Juifs?
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ዳግመኛ መልሶ። እንግዲህ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ የምትሉትን ምን ላደርገው ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.fr: Ils crièrent de nouveau: Crucifie-le!
verses.am: እነርሱም ዳግመኛ። ስቀለው እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.en: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.fr: Pilate leur dit: Quel mal a-t-il fait? Et ils crièrent encore plus fort: Crucifie-le!
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። ምን ነው? ያደረገው ክፋት ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱ ግን። ስቀለው እያሉ ጩኸት አበዙ።

verses.en: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
verses.fr: Pilate, voulant satisfaire la foule, leur relâcha Barabbas; et, après avoir fait battre de verges Jésus, il le livra pour être crucifié.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም የሕዝቡን ፈቃድ ሊያደርግ ወዶ በርባንን ፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስንም ገርፎ እንዲሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጠ።

verses.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
verses.fr: Les soldats conduisirent Jésus dans l''intérieur de la cour, c''est-à-dire, dans le prétoire, et ils assemblèrent toute la cohorte.
verses.am: ወታደሮችም ፕራይቶሪዮን ወደሚባል ግቢ ውስጥ ወሰዱት፥ ጭፍራውንም ሁሉ በአንድነት ጠሩ።

verses.en: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
verses.fr: Ils le revêtirent de pourpre, et posèrent sur sa tête une couronne d''épines, qu''ils avaient tressée.
verses.am: ቀይ ልብስም አለበሱት፥ የእሾህ አክሊልም ጎንጉነው ደፉበት፤

verses.en: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.fr: Puis ils se mirent à le saluer: Salut, roi des Juifs!
verses.am: የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን እያሉ እጅ ይነሱት ጀመር፤

verses.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
verses.fr: Et ils lui frappaient la tête avec un roseau, crachaient sur lui, et, fléchissant les genoux, ils se prosternaient devant lui.
verses.am: ራሱንም በመቃ መቱት ተፉበትም፥ ተንበርክከውም ሰገዱለት።

verses.en: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
verses.fr: Après s''être ainsi moqués de lui, ils lui ôtèrent la pourpre, lui remirent ses vêtements, et l''emmenèrent pour le crucifier.
verses.am: ከተዘባበቱበትም በኋላ ቀዩን ልብስ ገፈፉት፥ ልብሱንም አለበሱት፥ ሊሰቅሉትም ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
verses.fr: Ils forcèrent à porter la croix de Jésus un passant qui revenait des champs, Simon de Cyrène, père d''Alexandre et de Rufus;
verses.am: አንድ መንገድ አላፊም የአሌክስንድሮስና የሩፎስ አባት ስምዖን የተባለ የቀሬና ሰው ከገጠር ሲመጣ መስቀሉን ይሸከም ዘንድ አስገደዱት።

verses.en: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
verses.fr: et ils conduisirent Jésus au lieu nommé Golgotha, ce qui signifie lieu du crâne.
verses.am: ትርጓሜውም የራስ ቅል ስፍራ ወደሚሆን ጎልጎታ ወደተባለ ስፍራ ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
verses.fr: Ils lui donnèrent à boire du vin mêlé de myrrhe, mais il ne le prit pas.
verses.am: ከርቤም የተቀላቀለበትን የወይን ጠጅ እንዲጠጣ ሰጡት፤ እርሱ ግን አልተቀበለም።

verses.en: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
verses.fr: Ils le crucifièrent, et se partagèrent ses vêtements, en tirant au sort pour savoir ce que chacun aurait.
verses.am: ሰቀሉትም፥ ልብሱንም ማን ማን እንዲወስድ ዕጣ ተጣጥለው ተካፈሉ።

verses.en: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
verses.fr: C''était la troisième heure, quand ils le crucifièrent.
verses.am: በሰቀሉትም ጊዜ ሦስት ሰዓት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, The King Of The Jews.
verses.fr: L''inscription indiquant le sujet de sa condamnation portait ces mots: Le roi des Juifs.
verses.am: የክሱ ጽሕፈትም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ የሚል ተጽፎ ነበር።

verses.en: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
verses.fr: Ils crucifièrent avec lui deux brigands, l''un à sa droite, et l''autre à sa gauche.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት ወንበዶች አንዱን በቀኙ አንዱንም በግራው ሰቀሉ።

verses.en: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
verses.fr: Ainsi fut accompli ce que dit l''Ecriture: Il a été mis au nombre des malfaiteurs.
verses.am: መጽሐፍም። ከአመፀኞች ጋር ተቆጠረ ያለው ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
verses.fr: Les passants l''injuriaient, et secouaient la tête, en disant: Hé! toi qui détruis le temple, et qui le rebâtis en trois jours,
verses.am: የሚያልፉትም ራሳቸውን እየነቀነቁ ይሰድቡት ነበርና። ዋ፥ ቤተ መቅደስን የምታፈርስ በሦስት ቀንም የምትሠራ፥

verses.en: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
verses.fr: sauve-toi toi-même, en descendant de la croix!
verses.am: ከመስቀል ወርደህ ራስህን አድን አሉ።

verses.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs aussi, avec les scribes, se moquaient entre eux, et disaient: Il a sauvé les autres, et il ne peut se sauver lui-même!
verses.am: እንዲሁም የካህናት አለቆች ደግሞ ከጻፎች ጋር እርስ በርሳቸው እየተዘባበቱ። ሌሎችን አዳነ፤ ራሱን ሊያድን አይችልም፤

verses.en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
verses.fr: Que le Christ, le roi d''Israël, descende maintenant de la croix, afin que nous voyions et que nous croyions! Ceux qui étaient crucifiés avec lui l''insultaient aussi.
verses.am: አይተን እናምን ዘንድ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ክርስቶስ አሁን ከመስቀል ይውረድ አሉ። ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰቀሉት ይነቅፉት ነበር።

verses.en: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.fr: La sixième heure étant venue, il y eut des ténèbres sur toute la terre, jusqu''à la neuvième heure.
verses.am: ስድስት ሰዓትም በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጨለማ ሆነ።

verses.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.fr: Et à la neuvième heure, Jésus s''écria d''une voix forte: Eloï, Eloï, lama sabachthani? ce qui signifie: Mon Dieu, mon Dieu, pourquoi m''as-tu abandonné?
verses.am: በዘጠኝ ሰዓትም ኢየሱስ። ኤሎሄ፥ ኤሎሄ፥ ላማ ሰበቅታኒ? ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ፤ ትርጓሜውም አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ለምን ተውኸኝ? ማለት ነው።

verses.en: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns de ceux qui étaient là, l''ayant entendu, dirent: Voici, il appelle Elie.
verses.am: በዚያም ከቆሙት ሰዎች ሰምተው። እነሆ፥ ኤልያስን ይጠራል አሉ።

verses.en: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
verses.fr: Et l''un d''eux courut remplir une éponge de vinaigre, et, l''ayant fixée à un roseau, il lui donna à boire, en disant: Laissez, voyons si Elie viendra le descendre.
verses.am: አንዱም ሮጦ ሆምጣጤ በሰፍነግ ሞላ በመቃም አድርጎ። ተዉ፤ ኤልያስ ሊያወርደው ይመጣ እንደ ሆነ እንይ እያለ አጠጣው።

verses.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, ayant poussé un grand cri, expira.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ ነፍሱንም ሰጠ።

verses.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
verses.fr: Le voile du temple se déchira en deux, depuis le haut jusqu''en bas.
verses.am: የቤተ መቅደስም መጋረጃ ከላይ እስከ ታች ከሁለት ተቀደደ።

verses.en: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verses.fr: Le centenier, qui était en face de Jésus, voyant qu''il avait expiré de la sorte, dit: Assurément, cet homme était Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: በዚያም በአንጻሩ የቆመ የመቶ አለቃ እንደዚህ ጮኾ ነፍሱን እንደ ሰጠ ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ ሰው በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበረ አለ።

verses.en: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
verses.fr: Il y avait aussi des femmes qui regardaient de loin. Parmi elles étaient Marie de Magdala, Marie, mère de Jacques le mineur et de Joses, et Salomé,
verses.am: አሁንም በመሸ ጊዜ የሰንበት ዋዜማ የሆነ የማዘጋጀት ቀን ስለ ነበረ፥ የከበረ አማካሪ የሆነ የአርማትያስ ዮሴፍ መጣ፥

verses.en: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
verses.fr: qui le suivaient et le servaient lorsqu''il était en Galilée, et plusieurs autres qui étaient montées avec lui à Jérusalem.
verses.am: አሁንም በመሸ ጊዜ የሰንበት ዋዜማ የሆነ የማዘጋጀት ቀን ስለ ነበረ፥ የከበረ አማካሪ የሆነ የአርማትያስ ዮሴፍ መጣ፥

verses.en: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
verses.fr: Le soir étant venu, comme c''était la préparation, c''est-à-dire, la veille du sabbat, -
verses.am: እርሱም ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ይጠባበቅ ነበር፤ ደፍሮም ወደ ጲላጦስ ገባና የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው።

verses.en: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
verses.fr: arriva Joseph d''Arimathée, conseiller de distinction, qui lui-même attendait aussi le royaume de Dieu. Il osa se rendre vers Pilate, pour demander le corps de Jésus.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም አሁኑን እንዴት ሞተ ብሎ ተደነቀ፥ የመቶ አለቃውንም ጠርቶ ከሞተ ቆይቶአልን? ብሎ ጠየቀው፤

verses.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
verses.fr: Pilate s''étonna qu''il fût mort si tôt; fit venir le centenier et lui demanda s''il était mort depuis longtemps.
verses.am: ከመቶ አለቃውም ተረድቶ በድኑን ለዮሴፍ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
verses.fr: S''en étant assuré par le centenier, il donna le corps à Joseph.
verses.am: በፍታም ገዝቶ አውርዶም በበፍታ ከፈነው ከዓለትም በተወቀረ መቃብር አኖረው፥ በመቃብሩ ደጃፍም ድንጋይ አንከባለለ።

verses.en: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
verses.fr: Et Joseph, ayant acheté un linceul, descendit Jésus de la croix, l''enveloppa du linceul, et le déposa dans un sépulcre taillé dans le roc. Puis il roula une pierre à l''entrée du sépulcre.
verses.am: መግደላዊትም ማርያም የዮሳም እናት ማርያም ወዴት እንዳኖሩት ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
verses.fr: Marie de Magdala, et Marie, mère de Joses, regardaient où on le mettait.
verses.am: መግደላዊትም ማርያም የዮሳም እናት ማርያም ወዴት እንዳኖሩት ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.en: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.fr: Lorsque le sabbat fut passé, Marie de Magdala, Marie, mère de Jacques, et Salomé, achetèrent des aromates, afin d''aller embaumer Jésus.
verses.am: ሰንበትም ካለፈ በኋላ መግደላዊት ማርያም የያዕቆብም እናት ማርያም ሰሎሜም መጥተው ሊቀቡት ሽቱ ገዙ።

verses.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
verses.fr: Le premier jour de la semaine, elles se rendirent au sépulcre, de grand matin, comme le soleil venait de se lever.
verses.am: ከሳምንቱም በፊተኛው ቀን እጅግ በማለዳ ፀሐይ ከወጣ በኋላ ወደ መቃብር መጡ።

verses.en: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
verses.fr: Elles disaient entre elles: Qui nous roulera la pierre loin de l''entrée du sépulcre?
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ድንጋዩን ከመቃብር ደጃፍ ማን ያንከባልልልናል? ይባባሉ ነበር፤

verses.en: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
verses.fr: Et, levant les yeux, elles aperçurent que la pierre, qui était très grande, avait été roulée.
verses.am: ድንጋዩ እጅግ ትልቅ ነበርና፤ አሻቅበውም አይተው ድንጋዩ ተንከባሎ እንደ ነበር ተመለከቱ።

verses.en: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
verses.fr: Elles entrèrent dans le sépulcre, virent un jeune homme assis à droite vêtu d''une robe blanche, et elles furent épouvantées.
verses.am: ወደ መቃብሩም ገብተው ነጭ ልብስ የተጎናጸፈ ጎልማሳ በቀኝ በኩል ተቀምጦ አዩና ደነገጡ።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Ne vous épouvantez pas; vous cherchez Jésus de Nazareth, qui a été crucifié; il est ressuscité, il n''est point ici; voici le lieu où on l''avait mis.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። አትደንግጡ፤ የተሰቀለውን የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን ትፈልጋላችሁ፤ ተነሥቶአል፥ በዚህ የለም፤ እነሆ እርሱን ያኖሩበት ስፍራ።

verses.en: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
verses.fr: Mais allez dire à ses disciples et à Pierre qu''il vous précède en Galilée: c''est là que vous le verrez, comme il vous l''a dit.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሄዳችሁ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ለጴጥሮስም። ወደ ገሊላ ይቀድማችኋል፤ እንደ ነገራችሁ በዚያ ታዩታላችሁ ብላችሁ ንገሩአቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
verses.fr: Elles sortirent du sépulcre et s''enfuirent. La peur et le trouble les avaient saisies; et elles ne dirent rien à personne, à cause de leur effroi.
verses.am: መንቀጥቀጥና መደንገጥ ይዞአቸው ነበርና ወጥተው ከመቃብር ሸሹ፤ ይፈሩ ነበርና ለማንም አንዳች አልነገሩም። እነርሱም ያዘዛቸውን ሁሉ ለጴጥሮስና ከእርሱ ጋር ላሉት በአጭሩ ተናገሩ። ከዚህም በኋላ ኢየሱስ ራሱ ለዘላለም ድኅነት የሆነውን የማይለወጠውን ቅዱስ ወንጌል ከፀሐይ መውጫ እስከ መጥለቂያው ድረስ በእጃቸው ላከው።

verses.en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
verses.fr: Jésus, étant ressuscité le matin du premier jour de la semaine, apparut d''abord à Marie de Magdala, de laquelle il avait chassé sept démons.
verses.am: ከሳምንቱም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ማልዶ በተነሣ ጊዜ፥ አስቀድሞ ሰባት አጋንንት ላወጣላት ለመግደላዊት ማርያም ታየ።

verses.en: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.fr: Elle alla en porter la nouvelle à ceux qui avaient été avec lui, et qui s''affligeaient et pleuraient.
verses.am: እርስዋ ሄዳ ከእርሱ ጋር ሆነው ለነበሩት ሲያዝኑና ሲያለቅሱ ሳሉ አወራችላቸው፤

verses.en: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
verses.fr: Quand ils entendirent qu''il vivait, et qu''elle l''avait vu, ils ne le crurent point.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሕያው እንደ ሆነ ለእርስዋም እንደ ታያት ሲሰሙ አላመኑም።

verses.en: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
verses.fr: Après cela, il apparut, sous une autre forme, à deux d''entre eux qui étaient en chemin pour aller à la campagne.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ከእነርሱ ለሁለቱ ወደ ባላገር ሲሄዱ በመንገድ በሌላ መልክ ተገለጠ፤

verses.en: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
verses.fr: Ils revinrent l''annoncer aux autres, qui ne les crurent pas non plus.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሄደው ለሌሎቹ አወሩ፤ እነዚያንም ደግሞ አላመኑአቸውም።

verses.en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
verses.fr: Enfin, il apparut aux onze, pendant qu''ils étaient à table; et il leur reprocha leur incrédulité et la dureté de leur coeur, parce qu''ils n''avaient pas cru ceux qui l''avaient vu ressuscité.
verses.am: ኋላም በማዕድ ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ለአሥራ አንዱ ተገለጠ፥ ተነሥቶም ያዩትን ስላላመኑአቸው አለማመናቸውንና የልባቸውን ጥንካሬ ነቀፈ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: Allez par tout le monde, et prêchez la bonne nouvelle à toute la création.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ሂዱ ወንጌልንም ለፍጥረት ሁሉ ስበኩ።

verses.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
verses.fr: Celui qui croira et qui sera baptisé sera sauvé, mais celui qui ne croira pas sera condamné.
verses.am: ያመነ የተጠመቀም ይድናል፥ ያላመነ ግን ይፈረድበታል።

verses.en: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
verses.fr: Voici les miracles qui accompagneront ceux qui auront cru: en mon nom, ils chasseront les démons; ils parleront de nouvelles langues;
verses.am: ያመኑትንም እነዚህ ምልክቶች ይከተሉአቸዋል፤ በስሜ አጋንንትን ያወጣሉ፤ በአዲስ ቋንቋ ይናገራሉ፤ እባቦችን ይይዛሉ፥

verses.en: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
verses.fr: ils saisiront des serpents; s''ils boivent quelque breuvage mortel, il ne leur fera point de mal; ils imposeront les mains aux malades, et les malades, seront guéris.
verses.am: የሚገድልም ነገር ቢጠጡ አይጎዳቸውም፤ እጃቸውን በድውዮች ላይ ይጭናሉ እነርሱም ይድናሉ።

verses.en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, après leur avoir parlé, fut enlevé au ciel, et il s''assit à la droite de Dieu.
verses.am: ጌታ ኢየሱስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ከተናገረ በኋላ ወደ ሰማይ ዐረገ በእግዚአብሔርም ቀኝ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
verses.fr: Et ils s''en allèrent prêcher partout. Le Seigneur travaillait avec eux, et confirmait la parole par les miracles qui l''accompagnaient.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወጥተው በየስፍራው ሁሉ ሰበኩ፥ ጌታም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሠራ ነበር፥ በሚከተሉትም ምልክቶች ቃሉን ያጸና ነበር።
